using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.Entity;
using System.Linq;

namespace GTSErpSystem.BLL.Security;

public class Class_Groups
{
	private GTSdbEntities db = new GTSdbEntities();

	public int Insert(string Name, int Branch, bool SellPrice2, bool SellPrice3, bool LastPrice, bool AvergPrice, bool ProvePrice, int SelectSellPrice, bool QuantityMinZero)
	{
		int result = 0;
		User_Groups user_Groups = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.Name == Name).FirstOrDefault();
		if (user_Groups == null)
		{
			int iD = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Select((User_Groups x) => x.ID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			User_Groups user_Groups2 = new User_Groups();
			user_Groups2.ID = iD;
			user_Groups2.Name = Name;
			user_Groups2.BranchID = Branch;
			user_Groups2.SellPrice2 = SellPrice2;
			user_Groups2.SellPrice3 = SellPrice3;
			user_Groups2.LastPrice = LastPrice;
			user_Groups2.AvergPrice = AvergPrice;
			user_Groups2.ProvePrice = ProvePrice;
			user_Groups2.SelectSellPrice = SelectSellPrice;
			user_Groups2.SelectQuantityPrice = QuantityMinZero;
			user_Groups2.UserID_Add = LoginDetails.UserID;
			user_Groups2.UserBranch_Add = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			user_Groups2.UserMacAddress_Add = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			user_Groups2.UserDate_Add = DateTime.Now;
			db.User_Groups.Add(user_Groups2);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int Update(int ID, string Name, int Branch, bool SellPrice2, bool SellPrice3, bool LastPrice, bool AvergPrice, bool ProvePrice, int SelectSellPrice, bool QuantityMinZero)
	{
		int num = 0;
		User_Groups user_Groups = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.ID == ID).FirstOrDefault();
		User_Groups user_Groups2 = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.Name == Name && x.ID != ID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (user_Groups != null && user_Groups2 == null)
		{
			user_Groups.Name = Name;
			user_Groups.BranchID = Branch;
			user_Groups.SellPrice2 = SellPrice2;
			user_Groups.SellPrice3 = SellPrice3;
			user_Groups.LastPrice = LastPrice;
			user_Groups.AvergPrice = AvergPrice;
			user_Groups.ProvePrice = ProvePrice;
			user_Groups.SelectSellPrice = SelectSellPrice;
			user_Groups.SelectQuantityPrice = QuantityMinZero;
			user_Groups.UserID_Update = LoginDetails.UserID;
			user_Groups.UserBranch_Update = LoginDetails.GroupID;
			user_Groups.UserMacAddress_Update = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			user_Groups.UserDate_Update = DateTime.Now;
			num = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
			return 1;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	public int Delete(int Sn)
	{
		int result = 0;
		User_Groups user_Groups = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.ID == Sn).FirstOrDefault();
		User_Login user_Login = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)db.User_Login).Where((User_Login x) => x.GroupID == (int?)Sn).FirstOrDefault();
		if (user_Groups != null && user_Login == null)
		{
			db.User_Groups.Attach(user_Groups);
			db.User_Groups.Remove(user_Groups);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
			DeletePermission(Sn);
		}
		return result;
	}

	public void DeletePermission(int GPID)
	{
		List<User_Permission> list = ((IQueryable<User_Permission>)db.User_Permission).Where((User_Permission x) => x.GroupID == (int?)GPID).ToList();
		if (list == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (User_Permission item in list)
		{
			db.User_Permission.Attach(item);
			db.User_Permission.Remove(item);
		}
		((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
	}

	public List<User_Groups> GetAllUsers()
	{
		return ((IEnumerable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).ToList();
	}

	public List<User_Login> GetUsers()
	{
		return ((IEnumerable<User_Login>)db.User_Login).ToList();
	}

	public List<Account_Branch> GetAllBranch()
	{
		return ((IEnumerable<Account_Branch>)db.Account_Branch).ToList();
	}

	public string GetBranchName(int ID2)
	{
		return (from z in (IQueryable<Account_Branch>)db.Account_Branch
			where z.ID == ID2
			select z.Name).FirstOrDefault();
	}

	public List<User_Groups> GetAllGroups()
	{
		return ((IEnumerable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).ToList();
	}

	public List<User_SellPrice> GetAllUser_SellPrice()
	{
		return ((IEnumerable<User_SellPrice>)db.User_SellPrice).ToList();
	}

	public List<User_Screens> GetAllGroupsPermaion()
	{
		return ((IQueryable<User_Screens>)db.User_Screens).Where((User_Screens x) => x.ISShow == (bool?)true).ToList();
	}

	public List<User_Permission> GetPermassionByGroupID(int GroupId)
	{
		return ((IQueryable<User_Permission>)db.User_Permission).Where((User_Permission x) => x.GroupID == (int?)GroupId).ToList();
	}

	public int SLCID()
	{
		return Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Select((User_Groups x) => x.ID > 0).FirstOrDefault());
	}

	public int InsertOnePermassion(int GroupID, int ScreenID, bool Allow_Enter, bool Allow_Save, bool Allow_Edit, bool Allow_Delete, bool Allow_Print, bool Allow_Export, int User_Add, string mac)
	{
		int num = 0;
		User_Permission user_Permission = ((IQueryable<User_Permission>)db.User_Permission).Where((User_Permission x) => x.GroupID == (int?)GroupID && x.ScreenID == (int?)ScreenID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (user_Permission == null)
		{
			int iD = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<User_Permission>)db.User_Permission).Select((User_Permission p) => p.ID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			User_Permission user_Permission2 = new User_Permission();
			user_Permission2.ID = iD;
			user_Permission2.GroupID = GroupID;
			user_Permission2.ScreenID = ScreenID;
			user_Permission2.Allow_Enter = Allow_Enter;
			user_Permission2.Allow_Save = Allow_Save;
			user_Permission2.Allow_Edit = Allow_Edit;
			user_Permission2.Allow_Delete = Allow_Delete;
			user_Permission2.Allow_Print = Allow_Print;
			user_Permission2.Allow_Export = Allow_Export;
			user_Permission2.UserID_Add = LoginDetails.UserID;
			user_Permission2.UserBranch_Add = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			user_Permission2.UserMacAddress_Add = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			user_Permission2.UserDate_Add = DateTime.Now;
			db.User_Permission.Add(user_Permission2);
			return ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		user_Permission.Allow_Enter = Allow_Enter;
		user_Permission.Allow_Save = Allow_Save;
		user_Permission.Allow_Edit = Allow_Edit;
		user_Permission.Allow_Delete = Allow_Delete;
		user_Permission.Allow_Print = Allow_Print;
		user_Permission.Allow_Export = Allow_Export;
		user_Permission.UserID_Update = LoginDetails.UserID;
		user_Permission.UserBranch_Update = LoginDetails.GroupID;
		user_Permission.UserMacAddress_Update = LoginDetails.macAddress;
		user_Permission.UserDate_Update = DateTime.Now;
		num = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		return 1;
	}
}

		int BID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
		TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
			where x.BranchID == BID && x.IsActive == true
			select x).ToList();
		TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
		TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
	}

	private void BindCBBranch()
	{
		try
		{
			TxtBranch.DataSource = USR.GetAllBranch();
			TxtBranch.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtBranch.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtBranch.SelectedValue = 1;
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			MessageBox.Show("حدث خطأ اثناء الدخول برجاء الاتصال بالدعم الفني الخاص بالبرنامج", "تسجيل الدخول", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	public void LoginApp()
	{
		int Result = 0;
		Result = LGN.LOGIN(Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue), TxtPassword.Text);
		if (Result > 0)
		{
			Thread thread = new Thread(() =>
			{
				BeginInvoke((Action)(() =>
				{
					BindLogin(Result);
				}));
			});
			thread.Start();
			LoginDetails.GroupID = Result;
			LoginDetails.UserID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue);
			LoginDetails.UserName = TxtName.Text;
			LoginDetails.BranchID = (LoginDetails.BranchID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue));
			LoginDetails.macAddress = GetMACAddress10();
			GetRemmember();
			BindTxt();
			GetDataFromXml();
			Class_WaitFormFunc class_WaitFormFunc = new Class_WaitFormFunc();
			class_WaitFormFunc.Show(this);
			Thread.Sleep(50);
			((Control)(object)new FrmRestaurant()).Show();
			class_WaitFormFunc.Close();
			Hide();
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("لقد أدخلت اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور خاطئة برجاء ادخال البيانات صحيحة ثم حاول مرة أخري", "تسجيل الدخول", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			TxtPassword.Text = "";
			TxtPassword.Focus();
		}
	}

	private void BtnLogin_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		LoginApp();
	}

	private string GetMacAddress()
	{
		string text = string.Empty;
		NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
		foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in allNetworkInterfaces)
		{
			if (networkInterface.OperationalStatus == OperationalStatus.Up)
			{
				text += networkInterface.GetPhysicalAddress().ToString();
				break;
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	public string GetMACAddress10()
	{
		NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
		string text = string.Empty;
		NetworkInterface[] array = allNetworkInterfaces;
		foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in array)
		{
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				IPInterfaceProperties iPProperties = networkInterface.GetIPProperties();
				text = networkInterface.GetPhysicalAddress().ToString();
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private void GetDataFromXml()
	{
		try
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SaveConnectionForXml>));
			List<SaveConnectionForXml> list = new List<SaveConnectionForXml>();
			list = (List<SaveConnectionForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
			SaveConnectionForXml saveConnectionForXml = list[0];
			LoginDetails.nameServer = saveConnectionForXml._comboServer;
			LoginDetails.databaseServer = saveConnectionForXml._comboDatabase;
			LoginDetails.userNameServer = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtUser, "EF");
			LoginDetails.passServer = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtPassword, "EF");
			LoginDetails.ConnString = "Data Source=" + LoginDetails.nameServer + ";Initial Catalog=" + LoginDetails.databaseServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + LoginDetails.userNameServer + ";Password=" + LoginDetails.passServer;
			fileStream.Close();
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	private void GetPrintFromXml()
	{
		try
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\Print.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SavePrintForXml>));
			List<SavePrintForXml> list = new List<SavePrintForXml>();
			list = (List<SavePrintForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
			SavePrintForXml savePrintForXml = list[0];
			LoginDetails.DefualtPrint = savePrintForXml._PrintName;
			fileStream.Close();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	public void BindTxt()
	{
		try
		{
			Stting.SelectUSR(Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue), out var itemNameAr, out var itemNameEN, out var itemVatNum, out var itemIsVat, out var itemtafqitID, out var itemStoreID);
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR = itemNameAr;
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN = itemNameEN;
			LoginDetails.VatNum = itemVatNum;
			LoginDetails.IsVat = itemIsVat;
			LoginDetails.TafqitID = itemtafqitID;
			LoginDetails.StoreSN = itemStoreID;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.ToString(), "خطأ ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR = "مايكرو سمارت";
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN = "EgySmart";
			LoginDetails.VatNum = "123";
			LoginDetails.IsVat = false;
			LoginDetails.TafqitID = 1;
		}
	}

	private void TxtBranch_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{

		{
			int BID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
			TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
				where x.BranchID == BID
				select x).ToList();
			TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
			if (Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue) == 0)
			{

		catch (Exception)

				where x.BranchID == BID2
				select x).ToList();

			TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
		}
	}

	private void toggleSwitch1_Toggled(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string ietfLanguageTag = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture.IetfLanguageTag;
		string text = ietfLanguageTag;
		if (!(text == "ar-EG"))
		{
			if (text == "en-US")
			{
				Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
				LoginDetails.Lang = "ar-EG";
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
			LoginDetails.Lang = "en-US";
		}
		Controls.Clear();
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
	}

	private void linkLabel1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		linkLabel1.LinkVisited = true;
		Process.Start("http://www.gts-sa.com");
	}

	private void GetRemmember()
	{
		foreach (TblRemember item in (IEnumerable<TblRemember>)db.TblRemembers)
		{
			if (item.DateTimeRem.Value.Date == DateTime.Now.Date)
			{
				LoginDetails.remembers.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

	private void LblLang_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string ietfLanguageTag = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture.IetfLanguageTag;
		string text = ietfLanguageTag;
		if (!(text == "ar-EG"))
		{
			if (text == "en-US")
			{
				Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
				LoginDetails.Lang = "ar-EG";
				LblLang.Text = "AR";
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
			LoginDetails.Lang = "en-US";
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
		Controls.Clear();
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "en-US")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "AR";
		}
		else if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
	}

	public FrmSecurityGroup()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		CRTDataTablePermassions();
		BindGroups();
	}

	public void InsertPrivalge()
	{
		foreach (DataRow row in datatablePermassions.Rows)
		{
			GoupClass.InsertOnePermassion(GrpID, Convert.ToInt32(row[0].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[3].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[4].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[5].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[6].ToString()), Allow_Print: true, Allow_Export: true, LoginDetails.UserID, LoginDetails.macAddress);
		}
	}

		if (CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 3))
		{
			switch (MessageBox.Show("هل أنت متأكد من اضافة الصلاحيات الي المجموعة", "تأكيد الحفظ", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question))
			{
			case DialogResult.Yes:
				InsertPrivalge();
				MessageBox.Show("تم حفظ صلاحيات المجموعة بنجاح", "نجاح الحفظ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
				break;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	public void CRTDataTablePermassions()

		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("حذف", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("طباعة", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("إستخراج", typeof(bool));
	}

	private void BindGroups()
	{
		TxtGroups.DataSource = GRP.GetAllUsers().ToList();
		TxtGroups.DisplayMember = "Name";
		TxtGroups.ValueMember = "ID";
	}

	public void BindGridGroupsPrlivalges(int GroupId)
	{
		datatablePermassions.Clear();
		int num = 1;
		List<User_Permission> permassionByGroupID = GoupClass.GetPermassionByGroupID(GroupId);
		foreach (User_Screens item in from x in GoupClass.GetAllGroupsPermaion()
			orderby x.ScreenNum
			orderby x.ScreenTypeID
			select x)
		{
			User_Permission user_Permission = permassionByGroupID.Where((User_Permission x) => x.ScreenID == item.ID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (user_Permission == null)
			{
				datatablePermassions.Rows.Add(item.ID, num, item.Screen_Name, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				datatablePermassions.Rows.Add(item.ID, num, item.Screen_Name, user_Permission.Allow_Enter, user_Permission.Allow_Save, user_Permission.Allow_Edit, user_Permission.Allow_Delete, user_Permission.Allow_Print, user_Permission.Allow_Export);
			}
			num++;
		}
		gridControl1.DataSource = datatablePermassions;
	}

	private void TxtGroups_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			GrpID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroups.SelectedValue);
			BindGridGroupsPrlivalges(Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroups.SelectedValue));
		}
		catch
		{
			GrpID = 1;
			BindGridGroupsPrlivalges(1);
		}
	}

	private void gridControl1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
	}

	private void CheckAll_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		foreach (DataRow row in datatablePermassions.Rows)
		{
			if (CheckAll.IsOn)
			{
				row[3] = true;
				row[4] = true;
				row[5] = true;
				row[6] = true;
				row[7] = true;
			}
			else
			{
				row[3] = false;
				row[4] = false;
				row[5] = false;
				row[6] = false;
				row[7] = false;
			}
		}
		gridControl1.DataSource = datatablePermassions;
		if (CheckAll.IsOn)
		{
			CheckEnter.IsOn = true;
			CheckEdit.IsOn = true;
			CheckDelete.IsOn = true;
			CheckPrint.IsOn = true;
			CheckSave.IsOn = true;
		}
		else
		{
			CheckEnter.IsOn = false;
			CheckEdit.IsOn = false;
			CheckDelete.IsOn = false;
			CheckPrint.IsOn = false;
			CheckSave.IsOn = false;
		}
	}

	public FrmLogin()

		Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");

	private void BindCBGroups()
	{
		int BID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
		TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
			where x.BranchID == BID && x.IsActive == true
			select x).ToList();
		TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
		TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
	}

	private void BindCBBranch()
	{
		try
		{
			TxtBranch.DataSource = USR.GetAllBranch();
			TxtBranch.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtBranch.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtBranch.SelectedValue = 1;
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			MessageBox.Show("حدث خطأ اثناء الدخول برجاء الاتصال بالدعم الفني الخاص بالبرنامج", "تسجيل الدخول", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	public void LoginApp()
	{
		int Result = 0;
		Result = LGN.LOGIN(Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue), TxtPassword.Text);
		if (Result > 0)
		{
			Thread thread = new Thread(() =>
			{
				BeginInvoke((Action)(() =>
				{
					BindLogin(Result);
				}));
			});
			thread.Start();
			LoginDetails.GroupID = Result;
			LoginDetails.UserID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue);
			LoginDetails.UserName = TxtName.Text;
			LoginDetails.BranchID = (LoginDetails.BranchID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue));
			LoginDetails.macAddress = GetMACAddress10();
			GetRemmember();
			BindTxt();
			GetDataFromXml();
			Class_WaitFormFunc class_WaitFormFunc = new Class_WaitFormFunc();
			class_WaitFormFunc.Show(this);
			Thread.Sleep(50);
			((Control)(object)new FrmRestaurant()).Show();
			class_WaitFormFunc.Close();
			Hide();
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("لقد أدخلت اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور خاطئة برجاء ادخال البيانات صحيحة ثم حاول مرة أخري", "تسجيل الدخول", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			TxtPassword.Text = "";
			TxtPassword.Focus();
		}
	}

	private void BtnLogin_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)

	private string GetMacAddress()
	{
		string text = string.Empty;
		NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
		foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in allNetworkInterfaces)
		{
			if (networkInterface.OperationalStatus == OperationalStatus.Up)
			{
				text += networkInterface.GetPhysicalAddress().ToString();
				break;
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	public string GetMACAddress10()
	{
		NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
		string text = string.Empty;
		NetworkInterface[] array = allNetworkInterfaces;
		foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in array)
		{
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				IPInterfaceProperties iPProperties = networkInterface.GetIPProperties();
				text = networkInterface.GetPhysicalAddress().ToString();
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private void GetDataFromXml()
	{
		try
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SaveConnectionForXml>));
			List<SaveConnectionForXml> list = new List<SaveConnectionForXml>();
			list = (List<SaveConnectionForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
			SaveConnectionForXml saveConnectionForXml = list[0];
			LoginDetails.nameServer = saveConnectionForXml._comboServer;
			LoginDetails.databaseServer = saveConnectionForXml._comboDatabase;
			LoginDetails.userNameServer = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtUser, "EF");
			LoginDetails.passServer = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtPassword, "EF");
			LoginDetails.ConnString = "Data Source=" + LoginDetails.nameServer + ";Initial Catalog=" + LoginDetails.databaseServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + LoginDetails.userNameServer + ";Password=" + LoginDetails.passServer;
			fileStream.Close();
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	private void GetPrintFromXml()
	{
		try
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\Print.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SavePrintForXml>));
			List<SavePrintForXml> list = new List<SavePrintForXml>();
			list = (List<SavePrintForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
			SavePrintForXml savePrintForXml = list[0];
			LoginDetails.DefualtPrint = savePrintForXml._PrintName;
			fileStream.Close();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	public void BindTxt()
	{
		try
		{
			Stting.SelectUSR(Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue), out var itemNameAr, out var itemNameEN, out var itemVatNum, out var itemIsVat, out var itemtafqitID, out var itemStoreID);
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR = itemNameAr;
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN = itemNameEN;
			LoginDetails.VatNum = itemVatNum;
			LoginDetails.IsVat = itemIsVat;
			LoginDetails.TafqitID = itemtafqitID;
			LoginDetails.StoreSN = itemStoreID;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.ToString(), "خطأ ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR = "مايكرو سمارت";
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN = "EgySmart";
			LoginDetails.VatNum = "123";
			LoginDetails.IsVat = false;
			LoginDetails.TafqitID = 1;
		}
	}

	private void TxtBranch_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			int BID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
			TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
				where x.BranchID == BID
				select x).ToList();
			TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
			if (Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue) == 0)
			{
				TxtName.Text = "";
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			int BID2 = 1;
			TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllGroups()
				where x.BranchID == BID2
				select x).ToList();
			TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
		}
	}

	private void toggleSwitch1_Toggled(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string ietfLanguageTag = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture.IetfLanguageTag;
		string text = ietfLanguageTag;
		if (!(text == "ar-EG"))
		{
			if (text == "en-US")
			{
				Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
				LoginDetails.Lang = "ar-EG";
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
			LoginDetails.Lang = "en-US";
		}
		Controls.Clear();
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
	}

	private void linkLabel1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		linkLabel1.LinkVisited = true;
		Process.Start("http://www.gts-sa.com");
	}

	private void GetRemmember()
	{
		foreach (TblRemember item in (IEnumerable<TblRemember>)db.TblRemembers)
		{
			if (item.DateTimeRem.Value.Date == DateTime.Now.Date)
			{
				LoginDetails.remembers.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

	private void LblLang_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string ietfLanguageTag = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture.IetfLanguageTag;
		string text = ietfLanguageTag;
		if (!(text == "ar-EG"))
		{
			if (text == "en-US")
			{
				Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
				LoginDetails.Lang = "ar-EG";
				LblLang.Text = "AR";
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
			LoginDetails.Lang = "en-US";
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
		Controls.Clear();
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "en-US")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "AR";
		}
		else if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
	}

	protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
	{
		if (disposing && components != null)

			components.Dispose();
		}
		base.Dispose(disposing);
	}

	public FrmLogin3()
	{
		string text = LoadLangFromXml();
		Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(text);
		LoginDetails.Lang = text;
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
		MaterialSkinManager instance = MaterialSkinManager.Instance;
		instance.AddFormToManage((MaterialForm)(object)this);
		instance.Theme = (Themes)0;
		LblVirgin.Visible = LoginDetails.Lbl_CB_VirginShow;
		CBVirgin.Visible = LoginDetails.Lbl_CB_VirginShow;
		if (text == "en-US")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "AR";
		}
		else
		{
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
	}

	private string LoadLangFromXml()
	{
		string text = Path.Combine(Application.StartupPath, "LangConfig.xml");
		if (File.Exists(text))
		{
			XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Load(text);
			return xDocument.Root.Element("Culture")?.Value ?? "en-US";
		}
		return "en-US";
	}

	private void BindCBGroups()
	{
		int BID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
		TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
			where x.BranchID == BID && x.IsActive == true
			select x).ToList();
		TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
		TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
		CBVirgin.DataSource = ((IQueryable<Virg_Virgins>)db.Virg_Virgins).Where((Virg_Virgins x) => x.GroupShow >= (int?)LoginDetails.GroupID && x.FranchiseShow == (bool?)true).ToList();
		CBVirgin.DisplayMember = "Name";
		CBVirgin.ValueMember = "ID";
	}

	private void BindCBBranch()
	{
		try
		{
			TxtBranch.DataSource = USR.GetAllBranch();
			TxtBranch.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtBranch.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtBranch.SelectedValue = 1;
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			MessageBox.Show("حدث خطأ اثناء الدخول برجاء الاتصال بالدعم الفني الخاص بالبرنامج", "تسجيل الدخول", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	public void LoginApp()
	{
		int Result = 0;
		Result = LGN.LOGIN(Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue), TxtPassword.Text);
		if (Result > 0)
		{
			Thread thread = new Thread(() =>
			{
				((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)(Action)(() =>
				{
					BindLogin(Result);
				}));
			});
			thread.Start();
			LoginDetails.GroupID = Result;
			LoginDetails.UserID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue);
			LoginDetails.UserName = TxtName.Text;
			LoginDetails.BranchID = (LoginDetails.BranchID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue));
			LoginDetails.macAddress = GetMACAddress10();
			int BrnchCode = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
			TblSetting tblSetting = (from x in Stting.GetAll()
				where x.ID == BrnchCode
				select x).FirstOrDefault();
			LoginDetails.IsElectronicInvoice = Convert.ToBoolean(tblSetting.IsElectronicInvoice);
			GetRemmember();
			BindTxt();
			GetDataFromXml();
			Class_WaitFormFunc class_WaitFormFunc = new Class_WaitFormFunc();
			class_WaitFormFunc.Show((Form)(object)this);
			Thread.Sleep(50);
			FrmNameLogin(LoginDetails.TypeVerg);
			string databaseVersion = tblSetting.DatabaseVersion;
			int num = Stting.AddLoginLog(LoginDetails.UserID, LoginDetails.macAddress, LoginDetails.VergDate, databaseVersion);
			class_WaitFormFunc.Close();
			((Control)this).Hide();
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("لقد أدخلت اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور خاطئة برجاء ادخال البيانات صحيحة ثم حاول مرة أخري", "تسجيل الدخول", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			TxtPassword.Text = "";
			TxtPassword.Focus();
		}
	}

	private string GetMacAddress()
	{
		string text = string.Empty;
		NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
		foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in allNetworkInterfaces)
		{
			if (networkInterface.OperationalStatus == OperationalStatus.Up)
			{
				text += networkInterface.GetPhysicalAddress().ToString();
				break;
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	public string GetMACAddress10()
	{
		NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
		string text = string.Empty;
		NetworkInterface[] array = allNetworkInterfaces;
		foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in array)
		{
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				IPInterfaceProperties iPProperties = networkInterface.GetIPProperties();
				text = networkInterface.GetPhysicalAddress().ToString();
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private void GetDataFromXml()
	{
		try
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SaveConnectionForXml>));
			List<SaveConnectionForXml> list = new List<SaveConnectionForXml>();
			list = (List<SaveConnectionForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
			SaveConnectionForXml saveConnectionForXml = list[0];
			LoginDetails.nameServer = saveConnectionForXml._comboServer;
			LoginDetails.databaseServer = saveConnectionForXml._comboDatabase;
			LoginDetails.userNameServer = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtUser, "EF");
			LoginDetails.passServer = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtPassword, "EF");
			LoginDetails.ConnString = "Data Source=" + LoginDetails.nameServer + ";Initial Catalog=" + LoginDetails.databaseServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + LoginDetails.userNameServer + ";Password=" + LoginDetails.passServer;
			fileStream.Close();
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	private void GetPrintFromXml()
	{
		try
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\Print.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SavePrintForXml>));
			List<SavePrintForXml> list = new List<SavePrintForXml>();
			list = (List<SavePrintForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
			SavePrintForXml savePrintForXml = list[0];
			LoginDetails.DefualtPrint = savePrintForXml._PrintName;
			LoginDetails.DefualtPrintA4 = savePrintForXml._PrintNameA4;
			fileStream.Close();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	public void BindTxt()
	{
		try
		{
			Stting.SelectUSR(Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue), out var itemNameAr, out var itemNameEN, out var itemVatNum, out var _, out var itemtafqitID, out var itemStoreID);
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR = itemNameAr;
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN = itemNameEN;
			LoginDetails.VatNum = itemVatNum;
			LoginDetails.TafqitID = itemtafqitID;
			LoginDetails.StoreSN = itemStoreID;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.ToString(), "خطأ ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR = "جي تي اس";
			LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN = "GTS";
			LoginDetails.VatNum = "123";
			LoginDetails.TafqitID = 1;
		}
	}

	private void TxtBranch_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			int BID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtBranch.SelectedValue);
			TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
				where x.BranchID == BID
				select x).ToList();
			TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
			if (Convert.ToInt32(TxtName.SelectedValue) == 0)
			{
				TxtName.Text = "";
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			int BID2 = 1;
			TxtName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllGroups()
				where x.BranchID == BID2
				select x).ToList();
			TxtName.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtName.ValueMember = "ID";
		}
	}

	private void toggleSwitch1_Toggled(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string ietfLanguageTag = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture.IetfLanguageTag;
		string text = ietfLanguageTag;
		if (!(text == "ar-EG"))
		{
			if (text == "en-US")
			{
				Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
				LoginDetails.Lang = "ar-EG";
				LblLang.Text = "AR";
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
			LoginDetails.Lang = "en-US";
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
		((Control)this).Controls.Clear();
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "en-US")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "AR";
		}
		else if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
	}

	private void GetRemmember()
	{
		foreach (TblRemember item in (IEnumerable<TblRemember>)db.TblRemembers)
		{
			if (item.DateTimeRem.Value.Date == DateTime.Now.Date)
			{
				LoginDetails.remembers.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

	private void LblLang_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string ietfLanguageTag = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture.IetfLanguageTag;
		string text = ietfLanguageTag;
		if (!(text == "ar-EG"))
		{
			if (text == "en-US")
			{
				string text2 = "ar-EG";
				Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(text2);
				LoginDetails.Lang = text2;
				LblLang.Text = "AR";
				SaveLangToXml(text2);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			string text2 = "en-US";
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(text2);
			LoginDetails.Lang = text2;
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
			SaveLangToXml(text2);
		}
		((Control)this).Controls.Clear();
		InitializeComponent();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		TxtBranch.Focus();
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "en-US")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "AR";
		}
		else if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			LblLang.Text = "EN";
		}
		CBVirgin.Visible = LoginDetails.Lbl_CB_VirginShow;
	}

	private void SaveLangToXml(string culture)
	{
		string fileName = Path.Combine(Application.StartupPath, "LangConfig.xml");
		XDocument xDocument = new XDocument(new XElement("LangSettings", new XElement("Culture", culture)));
		xDocument.Save(fileName);
	}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Configuration;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using System.Xml.Serialization;

namespace GTSErpSystem.BLL.Main;

internal class ChangeConnection
{
	private Configuration conifg;

	public string DataBaseDefualt;

	public ChangeConnection()
	{
		conifg = ConfigurationManager.OpenExeConfiguration(ConfigurationUserLevel.None);
	}

	public string GetConnectionString(string Key)
	{
		return conifg.ConnectionStrings.ConnectionStrings[Key].ConnectionString;
	}

	public void SaveConnectionString(string key, string value)
	{
		Configuration configuration = ConfigurationManager.OpenExeConfiguration(ConfigurationUserLevel.None);
		ConnectionStringsSection connectionStringsSection = (ConnectionStringsSection)configuration.GetSection("connectionStrings");
		if (connectionStringsSection != null)
		{
			string connectionString = "metadata=res://*/Model1.csdl|res://*/Model1.ssdl|res://*/Model1.msl;provider=System.Data.SqlClient;provider connection string='" + value + ";MultipleActiveResultSets=True;App=EntityFramework'";
			connectionStringsSection.ConnectionStrings[key].ConnectionString = connectionString;
			connectionStringsSection.ConnectionStrings[key].ProviderName = "System.Data.EntityClient";
			configuration.Save(ConfigurationSaveMode.Modified);
			ConfigurationManager.RefreshSection("connectionStrings");
		}
	}

	public int TestCon()
	{
		int result = 0;
		try
		{
			GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
			User_Login user_Login = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)gTSdbEntities.User_Login).Where((User_Login x) => x.ID > 0).FirstOrDefault();
			result = Convert.ToInt32(user_Login.ID);
			return result;
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			DialogResult dialogResult = MessageBox.Show("حدث خطأ اثناء الاتصال بقاعدة البيانات ، سيتم تحويلك علي الاتصال بقاعدة البيانات", "خطأ في الاتصال", MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			if (dialogResult != DialogResult.OK && dialogResult == DialogResult.Cancel)
			{
				Application.Exit();
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public string GetSqlConnectionFromFile()
	{
		string text = "";
		string text2 = "";
		string text3 = "";
		string text4 = "";
		try
		{
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SaveConnectionForXml>));
			List<SaveConnectionForXml> list = new List<SaveConnectionForXml>();
			if (File.Exists(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml"))
			{
				FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
				list = (List<SaveConnectionForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
				SaveConnectionForXml saveConnectionForXml = list[0];
				text = saveConnectionForXml._comboServer;
				text2 = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtUser, "EF");
				text3 = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtPassword, "EF");
				text4 = (DataBaseDefualt = saveConnectionForXml._comboDatabase);
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
		return "data source=" + text + ";initial catalog=" + text4 + ";persist security info=True;user id=" + text2 + ";password=" + text3 + ";";
	}
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace GTSErpSystem.BLL.Main;

internal class Class_Login
{
	private GTSdbEntities db = new GTSdbEntities();

	public int LOGIN(int usrn, string pws)
	{
		string Password = Class_Encryption.EncryptString(pws, usrn.ToString());
		int result = 0;
		int num = Convert.ToInt32((from zz in (IQueryable<User_Login>)db.User_Login
			where zz.ID == usrn && zz.PassWord == Password
			select zz.GroupID).FirstOrDefault());
		if (num > 0)
		{
			result = num;
		}
		return result;
	}

	public List<User_Login> GetAllUser()
	{
		return ((IEnumerable<User_Login>)db.User_Login).ToList();
	}
}

	public int InsertItems_Complant(DataTable Items, string ItemCode)
	{
		int result = 0;
		foreach (DataRow row in Items.Rows)
		{
			if (row["كود_الصنف"].ToString() != "")
			{
				Item_ItemComponent item_ItemComponent = new Item_ItemComponent();
				string Itemcod = row["كود_الصنف"].ToString();
				string value = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == ItemCode).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
				string value2 = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
				int ItemRowChek = Convert.ToInt32(value2);
				Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items z) => z.ItemId == ItemRowChek).FirstOrDefault();
				if (item_Items != null)
				{
					item_ItemComponent.ItemID_Master = Convert.ToInt32(value);
					item_ItemComponent.ItemID_Complant = Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.ItemId);
					item_ItemComponent.Amount = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الكمية"].ToString());
					string nmae = row["الوحدة"].ToString();
					item_ItemComponent.ItemUnitID = GetUnitIdByName(nmae);
					item_ItemComponent.SmallUnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["م.التكلفة"].ToString());
					item_ItemComponent.TotalPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					item_ItemComponent.ItemUnitType = row["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString();
					item_ItemComponent.StoreID = Convert.ToInt32(row["رقم المخزن"]);
					db.Item_ItemComponent.Add(item_ItemComponent);
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int ItemQuantityIn(int ItemID, decimal Quantity, string unitType, int StoreID, int itemType)
	{
		GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
		int result = 0;
		if (ItemID > 0)
		{
			if (itemType == 1)
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)gTSdbEntities.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (itemQuantity != null)
				{
					ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
					if (itemQuantity2 != null)
					{
						if (unitType == "الصغرى")
						{
							itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance -= (decimal?)Quantity;

							decimal? convertMediumUnit = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
							itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance - (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();

							decimal value = Quantity;

	public string GetStoreName()
	{
		int StoreID = Convert.ToInt32((from x in (IQueryable<TblSetting>)db.TblSettings
			where x.ID == LoginDetails.BranchID
			select x.StoreID).SingleOrDefault());
		return (from x in (IQueryable<Account_Stores>)db.Account_Stores
			where x.ID == StoreID
			select x.Store_Name).FirstOrDefault();
	}

	public int GetStoreID()
	{
		return Convert.ToInt32((from x in (IQueryable<TblSetting>)db.TblSettings
			where x.ID == LoginDetails.BranchID
			select x.StoreID).SingleOrDefault());
	}

	}

	public decimal GetQantityForItems(string itemCode, string unit)
	{
		decimal num = 0m;
		int Itemid = (from x in GetItems(itemCode)
			select x.ItemId).FirstOrDefault();
		decimal num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.OpeningBalance));
		decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.CurrentBalance));
		num = num2 + num3;
		if (unit == "المتوسطة")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		if (unit == "الكبرى")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertBigUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		return num;
	}

		decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid && x.StoreID == (int?)storeid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.CurrentBalance));
		num = num2 + num3;

				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());

	public int InsertItems(DataTable Items, int Purchese_ID, bool IsWait)
	{
		int num = 0;
		DataTable changes = Items.GetChanges(DataRowState.Added);
		SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("Insert_Order_OrdersDetails", con);
		sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
		sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ISWaitng", IsWait);
		SqlParameter sqlParameter = sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Items", changes);
		sqlParameter.SqlDbType = SqlDbType.Structured;
		sqlCommand.CommandTimeout = 999999;
		if (con.State == ConnectionState.Closed)
		{
			con.Open();
		}
		num = sqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
		con.Close();
		return num;
	}

	public void deleteItemsByPurcahesId(int PurID)
	{
		List<Order_OrdersDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Order_OrdersDetails>)db.Order_OrdersDetails).Where((Order_OrdersDetails x) => x.Purchese_ID == (int?)PurID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (Order_OrdersDetails item in list)
		{
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => (int?)x.ItemId == item.ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (item_Items != null)
			{
				ItemQuantityOut(Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemID), Convert.ToDecimal(item.Quantity), item.ItemUnitType, Convert.ToInt32(item.StoreID), Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.item_Type));
			}
			Order_Orders order_Orders = ((IQueryable<Order_Orders>)db.Order_Orders).Where((Order_Orders z) => z.ID == PurID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (order_Orders.IsWaiting == true)
			{
				ItemQuantityIn(Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemID), Convert.ToDecimal(item.Quantity), item.ItemUnitType, LoginDetails.StoreIDWaiting, 1);
			}
			db.Order_OrdersDetails.Attach(item);
			db.Order_OrdersDetails.Remove(item);
		}
		((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
	}

	public int UpdateTran(out int TRNIDDS, int PurID, int PurType, string Name, string NoteNum, DateTime PurDate)
	{
		int result = 0;
		TRNIDDS = 0;
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)PurID && x.TranTypeID == (int?)5 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (tran_Tran != null)
		{
			tran_Tran.DocCode = NoteNum;
			tran_Tran.TranDate = PurDate;
			tran_Tran.BranchID = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			if (PurType == 2)
			{
				tran_Tran.Note = " مبيعات أجلة  رقم  ( " + PurID + " ) ح /  " + Name + " معدلة ";
			}
			else
			{
				tran_Tran.Note = " مبيعات نقدية  رقم ( " + PurID + " ) معدلة ";
			}
			tran_Tran.UserID_Update = LoginDetails.UserID;
			tran_Tran.UserBranch_Update = LoginDetails.GroupID;
			tran_Tran.UserMacAddress_Update = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			tran_Tran.UserDate_Update = DateTime.Now;
			TRNIDDS = Convert.ToInt32(tran_Tran.ID);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTran(int Code)
	{
		int result = 0;
		try
		{
			int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)5 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
			Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ID == TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (tran_Tran != null)
			{
				db.Tran_Tran.Attach(tran_Tran);
				db.Tran_Tran.Remove(tran_Tran);
				result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTranDetails(int Code)
	{
		int result = 0;
		try
		{
			int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)5 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
			List<Tran_TranDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Tran_TranDetails>)db.Tran_TranDetails).Where((Tran_TranDetails x) => x.TranSn == (int?)TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
			if (list != null)
			{
				foreach (Tran_TranDetails item in list)
				{
					db.Tran_TranDetails.Attach(item);
					db.Tran_TranDetails.Remove(item);
				}
				result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int GetItmID(string Code)
	{
		return (from xx in (IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items
			where xx.Item_code == Code
			select xx.ItemId).FirstOrDefault();
	}

	public decimal GetSellPermission(string Item_code, int UserSellPricePer, string Type)
	{
		decimal result = 0m;
		try
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			case "الصغرى":
				if (UserSellPricePer == 1)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellPriceSmall);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer == 2)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellPriceSmall2);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer == 3)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellPriceSmall3);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer >= 4)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().LastCost);
				}
				break;
			case "المتوسطة":
				if (UserSellPricePer == 1)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellPriceMedium);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer == 2)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellPriceMedium2);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer == 3)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellPriceMedium3);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer >= 4)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().LastCost2);
				}
				break;
			case "الكبرى":
				if (UserSellPricePer == 1)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellpriceLarge);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer == 2)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellpriceLarge2);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer == 3)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().SellpriceLarge3);
				}
				if (UserSellPricePer >= 4)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Item_code).FirstOrDefault().LastCost3);
				}
				break;
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			result = 0m;
		}
		return result;
	}

	public decimal GetQuantityPermission(int ItemID, int StoreID, string Type)
	{
		decimal result = 0m;
		try
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			case "الصغرى":
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (itemQuantity2 != null)
				{
					return Convert.ToDecimal(itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "المتوسطة":
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity3 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (itemQuantity3 != null)
				{
					decimal num4 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault().ConvertMediumUnit);
					decimal num5 = Convert.ToDecimal(itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance);
					return num5 / num4;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "الكبرى":
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (itemQuantity != null)
				{
					Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
					decimal num = Convert.ToDecimal(item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit);
					decimal num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(item_Items.ConvertBigUnit);
					decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(itemQuantity.CurrentBalance);
					return num3 / (num * num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			result = 0m;
		}
		return result;
	}

	public void updateOdrderMahlyType(int OdederID, decimal Cash, decimal Bank, decimal Discount)
	{
		int TRNIDDS = 0;
		Order_Orders order_Orders = ((IQueryable<Order_Orders>)db.Order_Orders).Where((Order_Orders x) => x.PurBranchID == (int?)OdederID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		decimal value = Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.CashMoney) + Cash;
		decimal value2 = Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.CashBank) + Bank;
		if (order_Orders != null)
		{
			order_Orders.Order_Paymant_Type = 1;
			order_Orders.CashMoney = value;
			order_Orders.CashBank = value2;
			((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)OdederID && x.TranTypeID == (int?)5 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (tran_Tran != null)
		{
			DeleteTranDetails(OdederID);
			DeleteTran(OdederID);
		}
		InsertTran(out TRNIDDS, OdederID, Convert.ToInt32(order_Orders.Order_Paymant_Type), order_Orders.SupplierName, order_Orders.NoteNum, Convert.ToDateTime(order_Orders.Purchases_Date));
		InsertTranDetailsCash(TRNIDDS, OdederID, Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.CostOrder), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.TotalPrices_Discount), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.TobaccoTax), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.AllTax), Convert.ToDecimal(Cash), Convert.ToDecimal(Bank), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.Net), 0);
		if (Discount > 0m)
		{
			InsertTranDetailsDiscount(TRNIDDS, OdederID, Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.CostOrder), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.TotalPrices_Discount), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.TobaccoTax), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.AllTax), Convert.ToDecimal(Cash), Convert.ToDecimal(Bank), Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.Net), 0, Discount);
		}
	}

	public void UpdateOrderDetialsIsPrint(int ORDID)
	{
		List<Order_OrdersDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Order_OrdersDetails>)db.Order_OrdersDetails).Where((Order_OrdersDetails x) => x.Purchese_ID == (int?)ORDID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (Order_OrdersDetails item in list)
		{
			item.IsPrint = true;
		}
		((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
	}

	public void DeleteRestaurant_Delivery(int PurID)
	{
		Restaurant_Delivery restaurant_Delivery = ((IQueryable<Restaurant_Delivery>)db.Restaurant_Delivery).Where((Restaurant_Delivery x) => x.OrderID == (int?)PurID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (restaurant_Delivery != null)
		{
			db.Restaurant_Delivery.Attach(restaurant_Delivery);
			db.Restaurant_Delivery.Remove(restaurant_Delivery);
			((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
	}

			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@IsPaymant", SqlDbType.Bit).Value = IsPaymant;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@RoomNum", SqlDbType.Int).Value = RoomNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@TableNum", SqlDbType.Int).Value = TableNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserID_Add", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.UserID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserMacAddress_Add", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			sqlCommand.CommandTimeout = 999999;
			if (con.State == ConnectionState.Closed)
			{
				con.Open();
			}
			result = sqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
			con.Close();
		}
		return result;
	}

				if (itemQuantity != null)
				{
					ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
					if (itemQuantity2 != null)
					{
						if (unitType == "الصغرى")
						{
							itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance += (decimal?)Quantity;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
						{
							decimal? currentBalance = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
							decimal value = Quantity;
							decimal? convertMediumUnit = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
							itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance + (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (unitType == "الكبرى")
						{
							decimal? currentBalance2 = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
							decimal value = Quantity;
							decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
							itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance2 + (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
					}
					return result;
				}
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity3 = new ItemQuantity();
				int itemQuantityID = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Select((ItemQuantity p) => p.ItemQuantityID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
				itemQuantity3.ItemQuantityID = itemQuantityID;
				itemQuantity3.ItemID = ItemID;
				if (unitType == "الصغرى")
				{
					itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = Quantity;
				}
				if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
				{
					decimal value = Quantity;
					decimal? currentBalance = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = (decimal?)value * currentBalance;
				}
				if (unitType == "الكبرى")
				{
					decimal value = Quantity;
					decimal? convertMediumUnit3 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit3 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
				}
				itemQuantity3.BeginningInventory = 0m;
				itemQuantity3.BeginningInventoryPrice = 0m;
				itemQuantity3.OpeningBalance = 0m;
				itemQuantity3.StoreID = StoreID;
				gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities.Add(itemQuantity3);
				result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
			}
			if (itemType == 3)
			{
				List<Item_ItemComponent> list = ((IQueryable<Item_ItemComponent>)gTSdbEntities.Item_ItemComponent).Where((Item_ItemComponent x) => x.ItemID_Master == (int?)ItemID).ToList();
				Item_Items item_Items2 = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)gTSdbEntities.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
				foreach (Item_ItemComponent item in list)
				{
					Item_Items item_Items3 = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)gTSdbEntities.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => (int?)x.ItemId == item.ItemID_Complant).FirstOrDefault();
					ItemQuantity itemQuantity4 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == item.ItemID_Complant && x.StoreID == item.StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
					if (itemQuantity4 != null)
					{
						ItemQuantity itemQuantity5 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == item.ItemID_Complant && x.StoreID == item.StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
						if (itemQuantity5 == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (unitType == "الصغرى")
						{
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items3.ConvertBigUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
						}
						if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
						{
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items2.ConvertMediumUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items2.ConvertMediumUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items3.ConvertBigUnit * item_Items2.ConvertMediumUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
						}
						if (unitType == "الكبرى")
						{
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items2.ConvertBigUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items2.ConvertBigUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
							if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
							{
								itemQuantity5.CurrentBalance += item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items3.ConvertBigUnit * item_Items2.ConvertBigUnit;
								result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					ItemQuantity itemQuantity6 = new ItemQuantity();
					int itemQuantityID2 = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities).Select((ItemQuantity p) => p.ItemQuantityID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
					itemQuantity6.ItemQuantityID = itemQuantityID2;
					itemQuantity6.ItemID = item.ItemID_Complant;
					if (unitType == "الصغرى")
					{
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items3.ConvertBigUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
					}
					if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
					{
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items2.ConvertMediumUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items2.ConvertMediumUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items3.ConvertBigUnit * item_Items2.ConvertMediumUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
					}
					if (unitType == "الكبرى")
					{
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items2.ConvertBigUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items2.ConvertBigUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
						if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
						{
							itemQuantity6.CurrentBalance = item.Amount * (decimal?)Quantity * item_Items3.ConvertMediumUnit * item_Items3.ConvertBigUnit * item_Items2.ConvertBigUnit;
							result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
						}
					}
					itemQuantity6.BeginningInventory = 0m;
					itemQuantity6.BeginningInventoryPrice = 0m;
					itemQuantity6.OpeningBalance = 0m;
					itemQuantity6.StoreID = item.StoreID;
					gTSdbEntities.ItemQuantities.Add(itemQuantity6);
					result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
				}
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public string GetStoreName()
	{
		int StoreID = Convert.ToInt32((from x in (IQueryable<TblSetting>)db.TblSettings
			where x.ID == LoginDetails.BranchID
			select x.StoreID).SingleOrDefault());
		return (from x in (IQueryable<Account_Stores>)db.Account_Stores
			where x.ID == StoreID
			select x.Store_Name).FirstOrDefault();
	}

	public decimal GetQantityForItems(string itemCode, string unit)
	{
		decimal num = 0m;
		int Itemid = (from x in GetItems(itemCode)
			select x.ItemId).FirstOrDefault();
		decimal num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.CurrentBalance));
		num = num2;
		if (unit == "المتوسطة")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		if (unit == "الكبرى")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertBigUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		return num;
	}

		num = num2;

				select x.ConvertBigUnit).FirstOrDefault());

	public MyObject ConvertRowToMyObject(DataRow row)
	{
		MyObject myObject = new MyObject();
		if (row["كود_الصنف"].ToString() != "")
		{
			string Itemcod = row["كود_الصنف"].ToString();
			myObject.ItemId = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
			myObject.SmallUnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعر الوحدة"].ToString());
			myObject.UnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعر الوحدة"].ToString());
			myObject.TotalPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"].ToString());
			myObject.Quantity = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الكمية"].ToString());
			myObject.NetUnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعربعدالخصم"].ToString());
			myObject.NetTotalPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["إجمالى_بعدالخصم"].ToString());
			myObject.VAT = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الضربية"].ToString());
			myObject.VAT_discount = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الضريبه_بعد_الخصم"].ToString());
			myObject.UnitType = row["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString();
			string nmae = row["الوحدة"].ToString();
			myObject.ItemUnitID = GetUnitIdByName(nmae);
		}
		return myObject;
	}

	public int GetUnitIdByName(string Nmae)

	}

	public int InsertItems(DataTable Items, int Purchese_ID, int CreditNote, int FromPurchID, bool IsWait)
	{
		int result = 0;
		if (!AvergItemTable.Columns.Contains("ItemId"))
		{
			AvergItemTable.Columns.Add("ItemId", typeof(int));
		}
		AvergItemTable.Clear();
		foreach (DataRow row in Items.Rows)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(row["ItemCode"].ToString()))
			{
				continue;
			}
			string Itemcod = row["ItemCode"].ToString();
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).FirstOrDefault((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod);
			if (item_Items == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			decimal num = Convert.ToDecimal(row["Quantity"]);
			if (!(num < 1m))
			{
				Order_OrderReturnDetails order_OrderReturnDetails = new Order_OrderReturnDetails
				{
					SnOrderDetails = Convert.ToInt32(row["SnOrder"]),
					Purchese_ID = Purchese_ID,
					FromPurchID = FromPurchID,
					BranchID = LoginDetails.BranchID,
					ItemID = item_Items.ItemId,
					ItemUnitID = GetUnitIdByName(row["UnitName"].ToString()),
					IsWaiting = IsWait,
					SmallUnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["UnitPrice"]),
					Quantity = Convert.ToDecimal(row["Quantity"]),
					StoreID = GetStoreIDByName(row["StoreName"].ToString()),
					CostAverg = Convert.ToDecimal(row["AvergItem"]),
					UnitPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["UnitPrice"]), DecimalNum),
					TotalPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["SumPrice"]), DecimalNum),
					NetUnitPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["UnitPriceDisc"]), DecimalNum),
					NetTotalPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["Net"]), DecimalNum),
					VAT = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["ItemVat"]), DecimalNum),
					ItemUnitType = row["UnitType"].ToString(),
					VAT_Discount = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["ItemVatDisc"]), DecimalNum),
					ItemNote = row["ItemNote"].ToString(),
					CreditNote = CreditNote,
					SumPriceInstall = ((row["SumPriceInstall"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToDecimal(row["SumPriceInstall"]) : 0m),
					SumPriceInstallDisc = ((row["SumPriceInstallDisc"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToDecimal(row["SumPriceInstallDisc"]) : 0m),
					Originalquantity = ((row["SellQuantity"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToDecimal(row["SellQuantity"]) : 0m),
					PercentDisc = ((row["PercentDisc"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToDecimal(row["PercentDisc"]) : 0m),
					AmountDisc = ((row["AmountDisc"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToDecimal(row["AmountDisc"]) : 0m)
				};
				int storeIDByName = GetStoreIDByName(row["StoreName"].ToString());
				db.Order_OrderReturnDetails.Add(order_OrderReturnDetails);
				result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				AvergItemTable.Rows.Add(item_Items.ItemId);
				if (item_Items.item_Type == 1 || item_Items.item_Type == 3)
				{
					ItemQuantityIN(item_Items.ItemId, Convert.ToDecimal(row["Quantity"]), row["UnitType"].ToString(), storeIDByName, 1);
				}
				if (IsWait)
				{
					ItemQuantityOut(item_Items.ItemId, Convert.ToDecimal(row["Quantity"]), row["UnitType"].ToString(), LoginDetails.StoreIDWaiting, 1);
				}
			}
		}
		if (AvergItemTable.Rows.Count > 0)
		{
			ExecuteBase(AvergItemTable);
		}
		return result;
	}

				if (IsWait)
				{
					ItemQuantityOut(item_Items.ItemId, Convert.ToDecimal(row["Quantity"]), row["UnitType"].ToString(), LoginDetails.StoreIDWaiting, 1);
				}
			}
		}
		if (AvergItemTable.Rows.Count > 0)
		{
			ExecuteBase(AvergItemTable);
		}
		return result;
	}

	public void ExecuteBase(DataTable AvergItemTable)
	{
		try
		{
			using SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection(LoginDetails.ConnString);
			using SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("Get_AvergItemByTable", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			sqlCommand.CommandTimeout = 30;
			SqlParameter sqlParameter = sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@AvergItem", AvergItemTable);
			sqlParameter.SqlDbType = SqlDbType.Structured;
			sqlConnection.Open();
			sqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}
		catch (SqlException)
		{
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	public void deleteItemsByPurcahesId(int PurID)
	{
		List<Order_OrderReturnDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Order_OrderReturnDetails>)db.Order_OrderReturnDetails).Where((Order_OrderReturnDetails x) => x.Purchese_ID == (int?)PurID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (Order_OrderReturnDetails item in list)
		{
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => (int?)x.ItemId == item.ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
			ItemQuantityOut(Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemID), Convert.ToDecimal(item.Quantity), item.ItemUnitType, Convert.ToInt32(item.StoreID), 1);
			Order_OrderReturn order_OrderReturn = ((IQueryable<Order_OrderReturn>)db.Order_OrderReturn).Where((Order_OrderReturn z) => z.ID == PurID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (Convert.ToBoolean(order_OrderReturn.IsWaiting))
			{
				ItemQuantityIN(Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemID), Convert.ToDecimal(item.Quantity), item.ItemUnitType, LoginDetails.StoreIDWaiting, 1);
			}
			db.Order_OrderReturnDetails.Attach(item);
			db.Order_OrderReturnDetails.Remove(item);
		}
		((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
	}

	public int Delete(int PurID, DataTable Items)
	{
		if (!AvergItemTable.Columns.Contains("ItemId"))
		{
			AvergItemTable.Columns.Add("ItemId", typeof(int));
		}
		int result = 0;
		Order_OrderReturn order_OrderReturn = ((IQueryable<Order_OrderReturn>)db.Order_OrderReturn).Where((Order_OrderReturn x) => x.PurBranchID == (int?)PurID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		int PurchCode = Convert.ToInt32(order_OrderReturn.FromPurchesID);
		if (order_OrderReturn != null)
		{
			deleteItemsByPurcahesId(PurID);
			db.Order_OrderReturn.Attach(order_OrderReturn);
			db.Order_OrderReturn.Remove(order_OrderReturn);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		Order_Orders order_Orders = ((IQueryable<Order_Orders>)db.Order_Orders).Where((Order_Orders x) => x.PurBranchID == (int?)PurchCode && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (order_Orders != null)
		{
			order_Orders.CreditNote = Convert.ToInt32(order_Orders.CreditNote) - 1;
			((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		AvergItemTable.Clear();
		foreach (DataRow row in Items.Rows)
		{
			string Itemcod = row["ItemCode"].ToString();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Itemcod))
			{
				Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).FirstOrDefault((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod);
				AvergItemTable.Rows.Add(item_Items.ItemId);
			}
		}
		if (AvergItemTable.Rows.Count > 0)
		{
			ExecuteBase(AvergItemTable);
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTran(int Code, int TranTypeID)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)TranTypeID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ID == TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (tran_Tran != null)
		{
			db.Tran_Tran.Attach(tran_Tran);
			db.Tran_Tran.Remove(tran_Tran);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTranDetails(int Code, int TranTypeID)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)TranTypeID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		List<Tran_TranDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Tran_TranDetails>)db.Tran_TranDetails).Where((Tran_TranDetails x) => x.TranSn == (int?)TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list != null)
		{
			foreach (Tran_TranDetails item in list)
			{
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Attach(item);
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Remove(item);
			}
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int InsertTranNum(out int TRNIDDS, int PurID, int PurType, string Name, string NoteNum, DateTime PurDate)
	{
		int num = 0;
		TRNIDDS = 0;
		int num2 = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Select((Tran_Tran p) => p.ID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = new Tran_Tran();
		tran_Tran.ID = num2;
		tran_Tran.ReferenceCode = PurID;
		tran_Tran.TranTypeID = 9;
		tran_Tran.DocCode = NoteNum;
		tran_Tran.TranDate = PurDate;
		tran_Tran.BranchID = LoginDetails.BranchID;
		if (PurType == 2)
		{
			tran_Tran.Note = "مرتجعات مبيعات أجلة رقم ( " + PurID + " ) ح /  " + Name;
		}
		else
		{
			tran_Tran.Note = "مرتجعات مبيعات نقدية رقم ( " + PurID + " )";
		}
		tran_Tran.UserID_Add = LoginDetails.UserID;
		tran_Tran.UserBranch_Add = LoginDetails.BranchID;
		tran_Tran.UserMacAddress_Add = LoginDetails.macAddress;
		tran_Tran.UserDate_Add = DateTime.Now;
		db.Tran_Tran.Add(tran_Tran);
		num = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		TRNIDDS = num2;
		return TRNIDDS;
	}

	public int DeleteTranNum(int Code, int TranTypeID)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)TranTypeID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ID == TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (tran_Tran != null)
		{
			db.Tran_Tran.Attach(tran_Tran);
			db.Tran_Tran.Remove(tran_Tran);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTranDetailsNum(int Code, int TranTypeID)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)TranTypeID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		List<Tran_TranDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Tran_TranDetails>)db.Tran_TranDetails).Where((Tran_TranDetails x) => x.TranSn == (int?)TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list != null)
		{
			foreach (Tran_TranDetails item in list)
			{
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Attach(item);
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Remove(item);
			}
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	{
