		if (order_OrderReturn != null)
		{
			order_OrderReturn.QRCode = newQRCode;
			order_OrderReturn.OrderTypeElectronicInvoiceId = OrderTypeId;
			order_OrderReturn.NormalOrSimpleInvoice = NormalOrSimpleInvoice;
			order_OrderReturn.ThirdParty = ThirdParty;
			order_OrderReturn.NominalInvoice = NominalInvoice;
			order_OrderReturn.ExportInvoice = ExportInvoice;
			order_OrderReturn.SummaryInvoice = SummaryInvoice;
			order_OrderReturn.SelfInvoice = SelfInvoice;

	public int InsertItems_Complant(DataTable Items, string ItemCode)
	{
		int result = 0;
		foreach (DataRow row in Items.Rows)
		{
			if (row["كود_الصنف"].ToString() != "")
			{
				Item_ItemComponent item_ItemComponent = new Item_ItemComponent();
				string Itemcod = row["كود_الصنف"].ToString();
				string value = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == ItemCode).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
				string value2 = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
				int ItemRowChek = Convert.ToInt32(value2);
				Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items z) => z.ItemId == ItemRowChek).FirstOrDefault();
				if (item_Items != null)
				{
					item_ItemComponent.ItemID_Master = Convert.ToInt32(value);
					item_ItemComponent.ItemID_Complant = Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.ItemId);
					item_ItemComponent.Amount = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الكمية"].ToString());
					string nmae = row["الوحدة"].ToString();
					item_ItemComponent.ItemUnitID = GetUnitIdByName(nmae);
					item_ItemComponent.SmallUnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["م.التكلفة"].ToString());
					item_ItemComponent.TotalPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					item_ItemComponent.ItemUnitType = row["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString();
					item_ItemComponent.StoreID = Convert.ToInt32(row["رقم المخزن"]);
					db.Item_ItemComponent.Add(item_ItemComponent);
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int ItemQuantityIn(int ItemID, decimal Quantity, string unitType, int StoreID, DateTime ExpireDate, decimal UnitNumber)
	{
		int result = 0;
		if (ItemID > 0)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = Convert.ToDateTime(ExpireDate.ToString("d"));
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (LoginDetails.IsPharmacy)
			{
				itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
			}
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (itemQuantity != null)
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (itemQuantity2 != null)
				{
					if (unitType == "الصغرى")
					{
						itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance += (decimal?)Quantity;
						itemQuantity2.UnitNumber += (decimal?)UnitNumber;
						result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					}
					if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
					{
						decimal? currentBalance = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
						decimal value = Quantity;
						decimal? convertMediumUnit = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
						itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance + (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit;
						itemQuantity2.UnitNumber += (decimal?)UnitNumber;
						result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					}
					if (unitType == "الكبرى")
					{
						decimal? currentBalance2 = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
						decimal value = Quantity;
						decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
						itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance2 + (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
						itemQuantity2.UnitNumber += (decimal?)UnitNumber;
						result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity3 = new ItemQuantity();
			int itemQuantityID = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Select((ItemQuantity p) => p.ItemQuantityID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			itemQuantity3.ItemQuantityID = itemQuantityID;
			itemQuantity3.ItemID = ItemID;
			if (unitType == "الصغرى")
			{
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = Quantity;
			}
			if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? currentBalance = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = (decimal?)value * currentBalance;
			}
			if (unitType == "الكبرى")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? convertMediumUnit3 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit3 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
			}
			itemQuantity3.UnitNumber = UnitNumber;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventory = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventoryPrice = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.OpeningBalance = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.StoreID = StoreID;
			db.ItemQuantities.Add(itemQuantity3);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int ItemQuantityOut(int ItemID, decimal Quantity, string unitType, int StoreID, decimal UnitNumber)
	{
		int result = 0;
		if (ItemID > 0)
		{
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (LoginDetails.IsPharmacy)
			{
				itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
			}
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (itemQuantity != null)
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (unitType == "الصغرى")
				{
					itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance -= (decimal?)Quantity;
					itemQuantity2.UnitNumber -= (decimal?)UnitNumber;
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
				if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
				{
					decimal? currentBalance = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
					decimal value = Quantity;
					decimal? convertMediumUnit = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance - (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity2.UnitNumber -= (decimal?)UnitNumber;
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
				if (unitType == "الكبرى")
				{
					decimal? currentBalance2 = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
					decimal value = Quantity;
					decimal? convertBigUnit = item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
					itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance2 - (decimal?)value * convertBigUnit * item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity2.UnitNumber -= (decimal?)UnitNumber;
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
				return result;
			}
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity3 = new ItemQuantity();
			int itemQuantityID = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Select((ItemQuantity p) => p.ItemQuantityID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			itemQuantity3.ItemQuantityID = itemQuantityID;
			itemQuantity3.ItemID = ItemID;
			if (unitType == "الصغرى")
			{
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = -Quantity;
			}
			if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? currentBalance = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = -((decimal?)value * currentBalance);
			}
			if (unitType == "الكبرى")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = -((decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit);
			}
			itemQuantity3.UnitNumber = -UnitNumber;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventory = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventoryPrice = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.OpeningBalance = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.StoreID = StoreID;
			db.ItemQuantities.Add(itemQuantity3);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public decimal GetQantityForItems(string itemCode, string unit)
	{
		decimal num = 0m;
		int Itemid = (from x in GetItems(itemCode)
			select x.ItemId).FirstOrDefault();
		decimal num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.OpeningBalance));
		decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.CurrentBalance));
		num = num2 + num3;
		if (unit == "المتوسطة")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		if (unit == "الكبرى")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertBigUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		return num;
	}

		decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid && x.StoreID == (int?)storeid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.CurrentBalance));
		num = num2 + num3;
		if (unit == "المتوسطة")

		if (unit == "الكبرى")

	public void Get_Item_AvargeCost(string itemcode, string unittype, decimal Lastcost)
	{
		try
		{
			GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
			try
			{
				Item_Items ItemDtails = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)gTSdbEntities.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items y) => y.Item_code == itemcode).FirstOrDefault();
				if (ItemDtails == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				decimal num = 0m;
				decimal num2 = 0m;
				decimal num3 = 0m;
				decimal num4 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesDetails>)gTSdbEntities.Order_PurchasesDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.Quantity));
				decimal num5 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesDetails>)gTSdbEntities.Order_PurchasesDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.Quantity));
				decimal num6 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesDetails>)gTSdbEntities.Order_PurchasesDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.Quantity));
				decimal num7 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesDetails>)gTSdbEntities.Order_PurchasesDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.NetTotalPrice));
				decimal num8 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesDetails>)gTSdbEntities.Order_PurchasesDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.NetTotalPrice));
				decimal num9 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesDetails>)gTSdbEntities.Order_PurchasesDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesDetails x) => x.NetTotalPrice));
				decimal value = num4;
				decimal value2 = num5;
				decimal? convertMediumUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
				decimal? num10 = (decimal?)value2 * convertMediumUnit;
				decimal? num11 = (decimal?)value + num10;
				value = num6;
				decimal? convertBigUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
				num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(num11 + (decimal?)value * convertBigUnit * ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit);
				num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(num7 + num8 + num9);
				num = ((!(num3 == 0m)) ? (num2 / num3) : Lastcost);
				ItemDtails.Average_cost = num;
				if (unittype == "الصغرى")
				{
					ItemDtails.LastCost = Lastcost;
					if (ItemDtails.UnitMedium > 0)
					{
						Item_Items item_Items = ItemDtails;
						value = Lastcost;
						decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
						item_Items.LastCost2 = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2;
					}
					if (ItemDtails.UnitLarge > 0)
					{
						Item_Items item_Items2 = ItemDtails;
						value = Lastcost;
						convertMediumUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
						item_Items2.LastCost3 = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit * ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
					}
				}
				if (unittype == "المتوسطة")
				{
					ItemDtails.LastCost2 = Lastcost;
					Item_Items item_Items3 = ItemDtails;
					value = Lastcost;
					num11 = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
					item_Items3.LastCost = (decimal?)value / num11;
					if (ItemDtails.UnitLarge > 0)
					{
						Item_Items item_Items4 = ItemDtails;
						value = Lastcost;
						num11 = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
						item_Items4.LastCost3 = (decimal?)value * num11;
					}
				}
				if (unittype == "الكبرى")
				{
					ItemDtails.LastCost3 = Lastcost;
					Item_Items item_Items5 = ItemDtails;
					value = Lastcost;
					num11 = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
					item_Items5.LastCost2 = (decimal?)value / num11;
					Item_Items item_Items6 = ItemDtails;
					value = Lastcost;
					convertMediumUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
					item_Items6.LastCost = (decimal?)value / convertMediumUnit / ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
				}
				((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	public int InsertOrders(out int Code, int SupplierID, string SupplierName, string SupplierPhone, string SupplierVatNum, DateTime Purchases_Date, int PurchType, int CostCenter, string Note, string NoteNum, decimal Tax, decimal TotalPrices, decimal Safy, decimal DiscountNum, decimal DiscountPerantage, decimal Tax_Discount, decimal TotalPrices_Discount, decimal Net, decimal Cash, decimal Bank, int Acc_Cash, int Acc_Bank, DataTable Items, decimal Charge, int ProjectId)
	{
		using (SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("Insert_Order_Purchases", con))
		{
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Clear();
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@BranchID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = SupplierID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierName", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = SupplierName;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierPhone", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = SupplierPhone;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierVatNum", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = SupplierVatNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Purchases_Date", SqlDbType.DateTime).Value = Purchases_Date;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Order_Paymant_Type", SqlDbType.Int).Value = PurchType;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@CostCentersID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = CostCenter;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Note", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = Note;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@NoteNum", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = NoteNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Tax", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Tax;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@TotalPrices", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = TotalPrices;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Safy", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Safy;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@DiscountNum", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = DiscountNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@DiscountPerantage", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = DiscountPerantage;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Tax_Discount", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Tax_Discount;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@TotalPrices_Discount", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = TotalPrices_Discount;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Net", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Net;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Cash", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Cash;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Bank", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Bank;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Acc_Cash", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Acc_Cash;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Acc_Bank", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Acc_Bank;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserID_Add", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.UserID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserBranch_Add", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserMacAddress_Add", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SalesMan", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = LoginDetails.UserName;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Charge", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Charge;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@ProjectId", SqlDbType.Int).Value = ProjectId;
			DataTable changes = Items.GetChanges(DataRowState.Added);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Items", changes);
			SqlParameter sqlParameter = sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Return Value", SqlDbType.Int);
			sqlParameter.Direction = ParameterDirection.ReturnValue;
			sqlCommand.CommandTimeout = 999999;
			if (con.State == ConnectionState.Closed)
			{
				con.Open();
			}
			Code = sqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
			object value = sqlParameter.Value;
			con.Close();
			Code = Convert.ToInt32(value);
		}
		return Code;
	}

	public int UpdateOrders(int Code, int SupplierID, string SupplierName, string SupplierPhone, string SupplierVatNum, DateTime Purchases_Date, int PurchType, int CostCenter, string Note, string NoteNum, decimal Tax, decimal TotalPrices, decimal Safy, decimal DiscountNum, decimal DiscountPerantage, decimal Tax_Discount, decimal TotalPrices_Discount, decimal Net, decimal Cash, decimal Bank, int Acc_Cash, int Acc_Bank, DataTable Items, decimal Charge, int projectId)
	{
		int result = 0;
		using (SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("Update_Order_Purchases", con))
		{
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Clear();
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@PurBranchID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Code;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@BranchID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = SupplierID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierName", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = SupplierName;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierPhone", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = SupplierPhone;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SupplierVatNum", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = SupplierVatNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Purchases_Date", SqlDbType.DateTime).Value = Purchases_Date;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Order_Paymant_Type", SqlDbType.Int).Value = PurchType;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@CostCentersID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = CostCenter;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Note", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = Note;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@NoteNum", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = NoteNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Tax", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Tax;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@TotalPrices", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = TotalPrices;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Safy", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Safy;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@DiscountNum", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = DiscountNum;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@DiscountPerantage", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = DiscountPerantage;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Tax_Discount", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Tax_Discount;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@TotalPrices_Discount", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = TotalPrices_Discount;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Net", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Net;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Cash", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Cash;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Bank", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Bank;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Acc_Cash", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Acc_Cash;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Acc_Bank", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Acc_Bank;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserID_Add", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.UserID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserBranch_Add", SqlDbType.Int).Value = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@UserMacAddress_Add", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@SalesMan", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = LoginDetails.UserName;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Charge", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = Charge;
			sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@projectId", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = projectId;
			DataTable changes = Items.GetChanges(DataRowState.Added);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Items", changes);
			SqlParameter sqlParameter = sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@Return Value", SqlDbType.Int);
			sqlParameter.Direction = ParameterDirection.ReturnValue;
			sqlCommand.CommandTimeout = 999999;
			if (con.State == ConnectionState.Closed)
			{
				con.Open();
			}
			result = sqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
			con.Close();
			result = 1;
		}
		return result;
	}

		}

	}

	public bool IsItemVat(int ItemID)
	{
		GTSdbEntities db = new GTSdbEntities();
		try
		{
			return (from s in (IQueryable<TblSetting>)db.TblSettings
				from i in (IEnumerable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items
				where i.ItemId == ItemID
				select (s.IsVat == (bool?)true && s.ItemTotalWithVat == (bool?)false && i.Is_Tax == (bool?)false) ? ((bool?)false) : ((bool?)null)).FirstOrDefault() ?? true;
		}
		finally
		{
			if (db != null)
			{
				((IDisposable)db).Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
}

				string value2 = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
				int ItemRowChek = Convert.ToInt32(value2);
				Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items z) => z.ItemId == ItemRowChek).FirstOrDefault();

			}
		}

	}

	public int ItemQuantityIn(int ItemID, decimal Quantity, string unitType, int StoreID, decimal UnitNumber)
	{
		int result = 0;
		if (ItemID > 0)
		{
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (itemQuantity != null)
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (itemQuantity2 != null)
				{
					if (unitType == "الصغرى")
					{
						itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance += (decimal?)Quantity;
						itemQuantity2.UnitNumber += (decimal?)UnitNumber;
						result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					}
					if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
					{
						decimal? currentBalance = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
						decimal value = Quantity;
						decimal? convertMediumUnit = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
						itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance + (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit;
						itemQuantity2.UnitNumber += (decimal?)UnitNumber;
						result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					}
					if (unitType == "الكبرى")
					{
						decimal? currentBalance2 = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
						decimal value = Quantity;
						decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
						itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance2 + (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
						itemQuantity2.UnitNumber += (decimal?)UnitNumber;
						result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity3 = new ItemQuantity();
			int itemQuantityID = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Select((ItemQuantity p) => p.ItemQuantityID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			itemQuantity3.ItemQuantityID = itemQuantityID;
			itemQuantity3.ItemID = ItemID;
			if (unitType == "الصغرى")
			{
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = Quantity;
			}
			if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? currentBalance = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = (decimal?)value * currentBalance;
			}
			if (unitType == "الكبرى")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? convertMediumUnit3 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit3 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
			}
			itemQuantity3.UnitNumber = UnitNumber;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventory = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventoryPrice = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.OpeningBalance = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.StoreID = StoreID;
			db.ItemQuantities.Add(itemQuantity3);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int ItemQuantityOut(int ItemID, decimal Quantity, string unitType, int StoreID, decimal UnitNumber)
	{
		int result = 0;
		if (ItemID > 0)
		{
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
			Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.ItemId == ItemID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (itemQuantity != null)
			{
				ItemQuantity itemQuantity2 = ((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)ItemID && x.StoreID == (int?)StoreID).FirstOrDefault();
				if (unitType == "الصغرى")
				{
					itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance -= (decimal?)Quantity;
					itemQuantity2.UnitNumber -= (decimal?)UnitNumber;
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
				if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
				{
					decimal? currentBalance = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
					decimal value = Quantity;
					decimal? convertMediumUnit = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance - (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity2.UnitNumber -= (decimal?)UnitNumber;
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
				if (unitType == "الكبرى")
				{
					decimal? currentBalance2 = itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance;
					decimal value = Quantity;
					decimal? convertBigUnit = item_Items.ConvertBigUnit;
					itemQuantity2.CurrentBalance = currentBalance2 - (decimal?)value * convertBigUnit * item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
					itemQuantity2.UnitNumber -= (decimal?)UnitNumber;
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
				}
				return result;
			}
			int itemQuantityID = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Select((ItemQuantity p) => p.ItemQuantityID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			ItemQuantity itemQuantity3 = new ItemQuantity();
			itemQuantity3.ItemQuantityID = itemQuantityID;
			itemQuantity3.ItemID = ItemID;
			itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = 0m;
			if (unitType == "الصغرى")
			{
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = -Quantity;
			}
			if (unitType == "المتوسطة")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? currentBalance = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = -((decimal?)value * currentBalance);
			}
			if (unitType == "الكبرى")
			{
				decimal value = Quantity;
				decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = item_Items.ConvertMediumUnit;
				itemQuantity3.CurrentBalance = -((decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2 * item_Items.ConvertBigUnit);
			}
			itemQuantity3.UnitNumber = -UnitNumber;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventory = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.BeginningInventoryPrice = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.OpeningBalance = 0m;
			itemQuantity3.StoreID = StoreID;
			db.ItemQuantities.Add(itemQuantity3);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public decimal GetQantityForItems(string itemCode, string unit)
	{
		decimal num = 0m;
		int Itemid = (from x in GetItems(itemCode)
			select x.ItemId).FirstOrDefault();
		decimal num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.OpeningBalance));
		decimal num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<ItemQuantity>)db.ItemQuantities).Where((ItemQuantity x) => x.ItemID == (int?)Itemid).Sum((ItemQuantity x) => x.CurrentBalance));
		num = num2 + num3;
		if (unit == "المتوسطة")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		if (unit == "الكبرى")
		{
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertMediumUnit).FirstOrDefault());
			num /= Convert.ToDecimal((from x in GetItems(itemCode)
				select x.ConvertBigUnit).FirstOrDefault());
		}
		return num;
	}

	public int InsertItems(DataTable Items, int Purchese_ID, int FromPurchID)
	{
		int result = 0;
		foreach (DataRow row in Items.Rows)
		{
			if (row["كود_الصنف"].ToString() != "")
			{
				Order_PurchasesReturnDetails order_PurchasesReturnDetails = new Order_PurchasesReturnDetails();
				string Itemcod = row["كود_الصنف"].ToString();
				string value = Convert.ToString(((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items x) => x.Item_code == Itemcod).FirstOrDefault().ItemId);
				int ItemRowChek = Convert.ToInt32(value);
				Item_Items item_Items = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items z) => z.ItemId == ItemRowChek).FirstOrDefault();
				if (item_Items != null)
				{
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.Purchese_ID = Purchese_ID;
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.FromPurchID = FromPurchID;
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.BranchID = LoginDetails.BranchID;
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.ItemID = Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.ItemId);
					string nmae = row["الوحدة"].ToString();
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.ItemUnitID = GetUnitIdByName(nmae);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.SmallUnitPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعر الوحدة"].ToString());
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.Quantity = Convert.ToDecimal(row["الكمية"].ToString());
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.UnitNumber = Convert.ToDecimal(row["عدد الوحدة"].ToString());
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.UnitPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعر الوحدة"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.TotalPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.NetUnitPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعربعدالخصم"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.NetTotalPrice = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["إجمالى_المبلغ"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.VAT = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الضربية"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.ItemUnitType = row["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString();
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.VAT_Discount = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الضريبه_بعد_الخصم"].ToString()), DecimalNum);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.StoreID = Convert.ToInt32(row["رقم المخزن"]);
					order_PurchasesReturnDetails.ItemNote = row["الشرح"].ToString();
					db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails.Add(order_PurchasesReturnDetails);
					result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
					ItemQuantityOut(Convert.ToInt32(value), Convert.ToDecimal(row["الكمية"]), row["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString(), Convert.ToInt32(row["رقم المخزن"]), Convert.ToDecimal(row["عدد الوحدة"]));
					UpdateAvergCost(ItemRowChek);
				}
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	private void UpdateAvergCost(int ItemId)
	{
		SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + LoginDetails.nameServer + ";Initial Catalog=" + LoginDetails.databaseServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + LoginDetails.userNameServer + ";Password=" + LoginDetails.passServer);
		decimal num = 0m;
		using SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("Get_AvergItem", sqlConnection);
		sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
		sqlCommand.Parameters.Clear();
		sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@ItemID", SqlDbType.Int).Value = ItemId;
		sqlCommand.Parameters.Add("@AvergItm", SqlDbType.Decimal).Value = num;
		sqlCommand.CommandTimeout = 999999;
		if (sqlConnection.State == ConnectionState.Closed)
		{
			sqlConnection.Open();
		}
		sqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
		sqlConnection.Close();
	}

	public void deleteItemsByPurcahesId(int PurID)
	{

		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (Order_PurchasesReturnDetails item in list)
		{
			ItemQuantityIn(Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemID), Convert.ToDecimal(item.Quantity), item.ItemUnitType, Convert.ToInt32(item.StoreID), Convert.ToDecimal(item.UnitNumber));
			db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails.Attach(item);
			db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails.Remove(item);

		((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
	}

	public int DeleteTran(int Code)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)18 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ID == TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (tran_Tran != null)
		{
			db.Tran_Tran.Attach(tran_Tran);
			db.Tran_Tran.Remove(tran_Tran);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTranDetails(int Code)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)18 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		List<Tran_TranDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Tran_TranDetails>)db.Tran_TranDetails).Where((Tran_TranDetails x) => x.TranSn == (int?)TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list != null)
		{
			foreach (Tran_TranDetails item in list)
			{
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Attach(item);
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Remove(item);
			}
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTranNum(int Code)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)8 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		Tran_Tran tran_Tran = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ID == TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (tran_Tran != null)
		{
			db.Tran_Tran.Attach(tran_Tran);
			db.Tran_Tran.Remove(tran_Tran);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int DeleteTranDetailsNum(int Code)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int TranID = ((IQueryable<Tran_Tran>)db.Tran_Tran).Where((Tran_Tran x) => x.ReferenceCode == (int?)Code && x.TranTypeID == (int?)8 && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).FirstOrDefault().ID;
		List<Tran_TranDetails> list = ((IQueryable<Tran_TranDetails>)db.Tran_TranDetails).Where((Tran_TranDetails x) => x.TranSn == (int?)TranID && x.BranchID == (int?)LoginDetails.BranchID).ToList();
		if (list != null)
		{
			foreach (Tran_TranDetails item in list)
			{
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Attach(item);
				db.Tran_TranDetails.Remove(item);
			}
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public void Get_Item_AvargeCost(string itemcode, string unittype, decimal Lastcost)
	{
		Item_Items ItemDtails = ((IQueryable<Item_Items>)db.Item_Items).Where((Item_Items y) => y.Item_code == itemcode).FirstOrDefault();
		if (ItemDtails == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		decimal num = 0m;
		decimal num2 = 0m;
		decimal num3 = 0m;
		decimal num4 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesReturnDetails>)db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.Quantity));
		decimal num5 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesReturnDetails>)db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.Quantity));
		decimal num6 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesReturnDetails>)db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.Quantity));
		decimal num7 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesReturnDetails>)db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.NetTotalPrice));
		decimal num8 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesReturnDetails>)db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.NetTotalPrice));
		decimal num9 = Convert.ToDecimal(((IQueryable<Order_PurchasesReturnDetails>)db.Order_PurchasesReturnDetails).Where((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى" && x.ItemID == (int?)ItemDtails.ItemId).Sum((Order_PurchasesReturnDetails x) => x.NetTotalPrice));
		decimal value = num4;
		decimal value2 = num5;
		decimal? convertMediumUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
		decimal? num10 = (decimal?)value2 * convertMediumUnit;
		decimal? num11 = (decimal?)value + num10;
		value = num6;
		decimal? convertBigUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
		num3 = Convert.ToDecimal(num11 + (decimal?)value * convertBigUnit * ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit);
		num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(num7 + num8 + num9);
		num = num2 / num3;
		ItemDtails.Average_cost = num;
		if (unittype == "الصغرى")
		{
			ItemDtails.LastCost = Lastcost;
			if (ItemDtails.UnitMedium > 0)
			{
				Item_Items item_Items = ItemDtails;
				value = Lastcost;
				decimal? convertMediumUnit2 = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
				item_Items.LastCost2 = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit2;
			}
			if (ItemDtails.UnitLarge > 0)
			{
				Item_Items item_Items2 = ItemDtails;
				value = Lastcost;
				convertMediumUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
				item_Items2.LastCost3 = (decimal?)value * convertMediumUnit * ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
			}
		}
		if (unittype == "المتوسطة")
		{
			ItemDtails.LastCost2 = Lastcost;
			Item_Items item_Items3 = ItemDtails;
			value = Lastcost;
			num11 = ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
			item_Items3.LastCost = (decimal?)value / num11;
			if (ItemDtails.UnitLarge > 0)
			{
				Item_Items item_Items4 = ItemDtails;
				value = Lastcost;
				num11 = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
				item_Items4.LastCost3 = (decimal?)value * num11;
			}
		}
		if (unittype == "الكبرى")
		{
			ItemDtails.LastCost3 = Lastcost;
			Item_Items item_Items5 = ItemDtails;
			value = Lastcost;
			num11 = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
			item_Items5.LastCost2 = (decimal?)value / num11;
			Item_Items item_Items6 = ItemDtails;
			value = Lastcost;
			convertMediumUnit = ItemDtails.ConvertBigUnit;
			item_Items6.LastCost = (decimal?)value / convertMediumUnit / ItemDtails.ConvertMediumUnit;
		}
		((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
	}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.Entity;
using System.Linq;

namespace GTSErpSystem.BLL.Security;

public class Class_Groups
{
	private GTSdbEntities db = new GTSdbEntities();

	public int Insert(string Name, int Branch, bool SellPrice2, bool SellPrice3, bool LastPrice, bool AvergPrice, bool ProvePrice, int SelectSellPrice, bool QuantityMinZero)
	{
		int result = 0;
		User_Groups user_Groups = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.Name == Name).FirstOrDefault();
		if (user_Groups == null)
		{
			int iD = Convert.ToInt32(((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Select((User_Groups x) => x.ID).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()) + 1;
			User_Groups user_Groups2 = new User_Groups();
			user_Groups2.ID = iD;
			user_Groups2.Name = Name;
			user_Groups2.BranchID = Branch;
			user_Groups2.SellPrice2 = SellPrice2;
			user_Groups2.SellPrice3 = SellPrice3;
			user_Groups2.LastPrice = LastPrice;
			user_Groups2.AvergPrice = AvergPrice;
			user_Groups2.ProvePrice = ProvePrice;
			user_Groups2.SelectSellPrice = SelectSellPrice;
			user_Groups2.SelectQuantityPrice = QuantityMinZero;
			user_Groups2.UserID_Add = LoginDetails.UserID;
			user_Groups2.UserBranch_Add = LoginDetails.BranchID;
			user_Groups2.UserMacAddress_Add = LoginDetails.macAddress;
			user_Groups2.UserDate_Add = DateTime.Now;
			db.User_Groups.Add(user_Groups2);
			result = ((DbContext)db).SaveChanges();
		}
		return result;
	}

	public int Update(int ID, string Name, int Branch, bool SellPrice2, bool SellPrice3, bool LastPrice, bool AvergPrice, bool ProvePrice, int SelectSellPrice, bool QuantityMinZero)
	{
		int num = 0;
		User_Groups user_Groups = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.ID == ID).FirstOrDefault();
		User_Groups user_Groups2 = ((IQueryable<User_Groups>)db.User_Groups).Where((User_Groups x) => x.Name == Name && x.ID != ID).FirstOrDefault();
		if (user_Groups != null && user_Groups2 == null)
		{

	{

				Conn.Open();

				Command = new SqlCommand(sql, Conn);
				Reader = Command.ExecuteReader();
				((CollectionBase)(object)comboDatabaseName.Properties.Items).Clear();
				while (Reader.Read())
				{
					comboDatabaseName.Properties.Items.Add((object)Reader[0].ToString());

				{

					string text = comboDatabaseName.SelectedItem.ToString();
					if (text.EndsWith("2025"))

						TxtNewDBName.Text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 4) + "2026";
					}
					else if (text.EndsWith("2026"))
					{
						TxtNewDBName.Text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 4) + "M2026";
					}
					else
					{
						TxtNewDBName.Text = text + "2026";
					}
				}
				MessageBox.Show("تم الاتصال بنجاح", "مستكشف الاتصال", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);

				return;
			}

		MessageBox.Show("عفوا، يرجي ادخال البيانات بشكل صحيح", "مستكشف الاتصال", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);

	private void GetAllServer()
	{
		DataTable dataSources = SqlDataSourceEnumerator.Instance.GetDataSources();

	public static InputLanguage GetInputLanguageByName(string inputName)
	{
		foreach (InputLanguage installedInputLanguage in InputLanguage.InstalledInputLanguages)
		{
			if (installedInputLanguage.Culture.EnglishName.ToLower().StartsWith(inputName))
			{
				return installedInputLanguage;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private void SetKeyboardLayout(InputLanguage layout)
	{
		InputLanguage.CurrentInputLanguage = layout;
	}

	private void BindServer()
	{
		string text = "";
		string text2 = "";
		string text3 = "";
		string text4 = "";
		try
		{
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(List<SaveConnectionForXml>));
			List<SaveConnectionForXml> list = new List<SaveConnectionForXml>();
			if (File.Exists(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml"))
			{
				FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(Application.StartupPath + "\\ERP.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
				list = (List<SaveConnectionForXml>)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(fileStream);
				SaveConnectionForXml saveConnectionForXml = list[0];
				text = saveConnectionForXml._comboServer;
				text2 = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtUser, "EF");
				text3 = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(saveConnectionForXml._TxtPassword, "EF");
				text4 = saveConnectionForXml._comboDatabase;
				comboServerName.Text = text;
				TxtUser.Text = text2;
				TxtPassword.Text = text3;
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	private void comboDatabaseName_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		if (((CollectionBase)(object)comboDatabaseName.Properties.Items).Count > 0)
		{
			string text = comboDatabaseName.SelectedItem.ToString();
			if (text.EndsWith("2025"))
			{
				TxtNewDBName.Text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 4) + "2026";
			}
			else if (text.EndsWith("2026"))
			{
				TxtNewDBName.Text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 4) + "M2026";
			}
			else
			{
				TxtNewDBName.Text = text + "2026";
			}
		}
	}

	public FrmGenetareCSID()
	{
		InitializeComponent();
		Bind();
	}

	private void Bind()
	{
		CBUserName.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
			where x.BranchID == LoginDetails.BranchID
			select x).ToList();
		CBUserName.DisplayMember = "Name";
		CBUserName.ValueMember = "ID";
		CBUserName.DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList;
		CBUserName.SelectedValue = LoginDetails.UserID;
		if (LoginDetails.CsIdForUser)
		{
			CKUsers.Checked = true;
		}
		List<InvoicType> dataSource = new List<InvoicType>
		{
			new InvoicType
			{
				Text = "Standard &Simplified Invoices ** فاتورة ضريبية & مبسطة ",
				Value = "1100"
			},
			new InvoicType
			{
				Text = "Standard Invoices Only ** فاتورة ضريبية فقط ",
				Value = "1000"
			},
			new InvoicType
			{
				Text = "Simplified Invoices Only ** فاتورة مبسطة فقط",
				Value = "0100"
			}
		};
		CBInvoicType.DisplayMember = "Text";
		CBInvoicType.ValueMember = "Value";
		CBInvoicType.DataSource = dataSource;
		CBInvoicType.DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList;
		TxtBranch.Text = USR.GetBranchById(LoginDetails.BranchID);
		TxtAddress.Text = LoginDetails.Address;
		TxtVatNum.Text = LoginDetails.VatNum;
		TxtCrs.Text = LoginDetails.Crs;
		TxtPrivateKey.Text = LoginDetails.PrivateKey;
		TxtPublicKey.Text = LoginDetails.PublicKey;
		TxtSecrt.Text = LoginDetails.SecretKey;
		TxtNum.Text = "1-MajedSoftDiskTop|2-Version 1|3-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
		CheckSimulation.Checked = true;
		if (CKUsers.Checked)
		{
			CBUserName.Visible = true;
		}
		else
		{
			CBUserName.Visible = false;
		}
		ISChange = true;
	}

	private void CKUsers_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		if (CKUsers.Checked)
		{
			CBUserName.Visible = true;
		}
		else
		{
			CBUserName.Visible = false;
		}
	}

	private void Clear()
	{
		TxtCrs.Text = string.Empty;
		TxtPrivateKey.Text = string.Empty;
		TxtPublicKey.Text = string.Empty;
		TxtSecrt.Text = string.Empty;
	}

	private void BtnNew_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		Clear();
	}

	private void CBUserName_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		if (ISChange)
		{
			User_Login userById = USR.GetUserById(Convert.ToInt32(CBUserName.SelectedValue));
			LoginDetails.Crs = userById.Crs;
			LoginDetails.PrivateKey = userById.PrivateKey;
			LoginDetails.PublicKey = userById.PublicKey;
			LoginDetails.SecretKey = userById.SecretKey;
			TxtCrs.Text = LoginDetails.Crs;
			TxtPrivateKey.Text = LoginDetails.PrivateKey;
			TxtPublicKey.Text = LoginDetails.PublicKey;
			TxtSecrt.Text = LoginDetails.SecretKey;
		}
	}

	private void BtnCreate_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			waitForm.Show();
			CertificateRequestDto certificateRequestDto = GenerateCsId(ElectronicInvoiceInfo.SupplierPartyDto(), CertificateRequestDto());
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(certificateRequestDto.ErrorMessage))
			{
				waitForm.Close();
				MessageBox.Show(certificateRequestDto.ErrorMessage, "خطأ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
				return;
			}
			TxtCrs.Text = certificateRequestDto.Csr;
			TxtPrivateKey.Text = certificateRequestDto.Privatekey;
			TxtPublicKey.Text = certificateRequestDto.Publickey;
			TxtSecrt.Text = certificateRequestDto.Secretkey;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "خطأ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
		finally
		{
			waitForm.Close();
		}
	}

	private void BtnSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		string modeInvoice = "developer";
		if (CheckSimulation.Checked)
		{
			modeInvoice = "Simulation";
		}
		else if (CheckProduction.Checked)
		{
			modeInvoice = "Production";
		}
		int num = 0;
		if (!CKUsers.Checked)
		{
			num = Userx.UpdateToElctorncInvoic(TxtCrs.Text, TxtPrivateKey.Text, TxtPublicKey.Text, TxtSecrt.Text, CsIdForUser: false, modeInvoice);
			LoginDetails.CsIdForUser = false;
		}
		else
		{
			num = USR.UpdateToElctroncInvoic(Convert.ToInt32(CBUserName.SelectedValue), CBUserName.Text, TxtCrs.Text, TxtPrivateKey.Text, TxtPublicKey.Text, TxtSecrt.Text, modeInvoice);
			Userx.UpdateToElctorncInvoicUser();
			LoginDetails.CsIdForUser = true;
		}
		if (num > 0)
		{
			LoginDetails.Crs = TxtCrs.Text;
			LoginDetails.PrivateKey = TxtPrivateKey.Text;
			LoginDetails.PublicKey = TxtPublicKey.Text;
			LoginDetails.SecretKey = TxtSecrt.Text;
			LoginDetails.ModeInvoice = modeInvoice;
			MessageBox.Show("تم حفظ بيانات اعدادات الفاتوره الالكتونيه بنجاح", "نجاح التعديل", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
		}
	}

	private CertificateRequestDto GenerateCsId(SupplierPartyDto supplier, CertificateRequestDto requestDto)
	{
		//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0007: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		//IL_00d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00db: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		//IL_0375: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_037b: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0094: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		//IL_046f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0479: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0480: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		Invoice val = new Invoice();
		val.ID = "INV00001";
		val.IssueDate = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
		val.IssueTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss");
		val.DocumentCurrencyCode = "SAR";
		val.TaxCurrencyCode = "SAR";
		if (val.invoiceTypeCode.id == 383 || val.invoiceTypeCode.id == 381)
		{
			InvoiceDocumentReference val2 = new InvoiceDocumentReference();
			val2.ID = "Invoice Number: 354; Invoice Issue Date: 2021-02-10";
			((Collection<InvoiceDocumentReference>)(object)val.billingReference.invoiceDocumentReferences).Add(val2);
		}
		val.AdditionalDocumentReferencePIH.EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject = "NWZlY2ViNjZmZmM4NmYzOGQ5NTI3ODZjNmQ2OTZjNzljMmRiYzIzOWRkNGU5MWI0NjcyOWQ3M2EyN2ZiNTdlOQ==";
		val.AdditionalDocumentReferenceICV.UUID = 123L;
		PaymentMeans val3 = new PaymentMeans();
		val3.PaymentMeansCode = "10";
		val3.InstructionNote = "Payment Notes";
		((Collection<PaymentMeans>)(object)val.paymentmeans).Add(val3);
		val.SupplierParty.partyIdentification.ID = supplier.ID;
		val.SupplierParty.partyIdentification.schemeID = supplier.schemeID;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.StreetName = supplier.StreetName;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.AdditionalStreetName = supplier.AdditionalStreetName;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.BuildingNumber = supplier.BuildingNumber;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.PlotIdentification = supplier.PlotIdentification;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.CityName = supplier.CityName;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.PostalZone = supplier.PostalZone;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.CountrySubentity = supplier.CountrySubentity;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.CitySubdivisionName = supplier.CitySubdivisionName;
		val.SupplierParty.postalAddress.country.IdentificationCode = supplier.IdentificationCode;
		val.SupplierParty.partyLegalEntity.RegistrationName = supplier.RegistrationName;
		val.SupplierParty.partyTaxScheme.CompanyID = supplier.CompanyID;
		val.CustomerParty.partyIdentification.ID = "1234567";
		val.CustomerParty.partyIdentification.schemeID = "CRN";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.StreetName = "شارع تجربة";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.AdditionalStreetName = "شارع اضافى";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.BuildingNumber = "1234";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.PlotIdentification = "9833";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.CityName = "Jeddah";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.PostalZone = "12345";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.CountrySubentity = "Makkah";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.CitySubdivisionName = "المحافظة";
		val.CustomerParty.postalAddress.country.IdentificationCode = "SA";
		val.CustomerParty.partyLegalEntity.RegistrationName = "اسم شركة المشترى";
		val.CustomerParty.partyTaxScheme.CompanyID = "310424415000003";
		val.legalMonetaryTotal.PrepaidAmount = 0m;
		val.legalMonetaryTotal.PayableAmount = 0m;
		InvoiceLine val4 = new InvoiceLine();
		val4.InvoiceQuantity = 1m;
		val4.item.Name = "منتج تجربة";
		val4.item.classifiedTaxCategory.ID = "S";
		val4.taxTotal.TaxSubtotal.taxCategory.ID = "S";
		val4.item.classifiedTaxCategory.Percent = 15m;
		val4.taxTotal.TaxSubtotal.taxCategory.Percent = 15m;
		val4.price.PriceAmount = 120m;
		((Collection<InvoiceLine>)(object)val.InvoiceLines).Add(val4);
		CertificateRequest cSRRequest = GetCSRRequest(requestDto);
		if (requestDto.Mode == "Simulation")
		{
			mode = (Mode)1;
		}
		else if (requestDto.Mode == "Production")
		{
			mode = (Mode)2;
		}
		else
		{
			mode = (Mode)0;
		}
		CSIDGenerator val5 = new CSIDGenerator(mode, "EN");
		string text = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() + "\\Invoices";
		CertificateResponse val6 = val5.GenerateCSID(cSRRequest, val, text);
		if (val6.IsSuccess)
		{
			requestDto.Csr = val6.CSR;
			requestDto.Privatekey = val6.PrivateKey;
			requestDto.Publickey = val6.CSID;
			requestDto.Secretkey = val6.SecretKey;
		}
		else
		{
			requestDto.ErrorMessage = val6.ErrorMessage;
		}
		return requestDto;
	}

	private CertificateRequest GetCSRRequest(CertificateRequestDto requestDto)
	{
		//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0007: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		CertificateRequest val = new CertificateRequest();
		val.OTP = requestDto.OTP;
		val.CommonName = requestDto.CommonName;
		val.OrganizationName = requestDto.OrganizationName;
		val.OrganizationUnitName = requestDto.OrganizationUnitName;
		val.CountryName = requestDto.CountryName;
		val.SerialNumber = requestDto.SerialNumber;
		val.OrganizationIdentifier = requestDto.OrganizationIdentifier;
		val.Location = requestDto.Location;
		val.BusinessCategory = requestDto.BusinessCategory;
		val.InvoiceType = requestDto.InvoiceType;
		return val;
	}

	private CertificateRequestDto CertificateRequestDto()
	{
		if (CheckProduction.Checked)
		{
			_Mode = "Production";
		}
		else
		{
			_Mode = "Simulation";
		}
		CertificateRequestDto certificateRequestDto = new CertificateRequestDto();
		certificateRequestDto.OTP = TxtOtp.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.CommonName = TxtHull.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.OrganizationName = TxtBranch.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.OrganizationUnitName = TxtVatNum.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.CountryName = TxtCountryCode.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.SerialNumber = TxtNum.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.OrganizationIdentifier = TxtVatNum.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.Location = TxtAddress.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.BusinessCategory = TxtTypeApp.Text;
		certificateRequestDto.InvoiceType = CBInvoicType.SelectedValue.ToString();
		certificateRequestDto.Mode = _Mode;
		return certificateRequestDto;
	}

	private void gridView1_ValidateRow(object sender, ValidateRowEventArgs e)
	{
		string text = Convert.ToString(((ColumnView)gridView1).GetRowCellValue(((RowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, "كود_الصنف"));
		string text2 = Convert.ToString(((ColumnView)gridView1).GetRowCellValue(((RowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, "أسم الصنف"));
		decimal num = Convert.ToDecimal(((ColumnView)gridView1).GetRowCellValue(((RowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, "الكمية"));
		if (text == "" || text2 == "" || num <= 0m)
		{
			Get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result = ITM.GetItemByCode(text).FirstOrDefault();
			if (get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result != null)
			{
				e.Valid = false;
				if (text == "")
				{
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle = ((RowEventArgs)e).RowHandle;
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedColumn = ((ColumnView)gridView1).VisibleColumns[0];
					((BaseView)gridView1).ShowEditor();
				}
				else if (text2 == "")
				{
					MessageBox.Show("برجاء إدخال أسم صنف");
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle = ((RowEventArgs)e).RowHandle;
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedColumn = ((ColumnView)gridView1).VisibleColumns[0];
					((BaseView)gridView1).ShowEditor();
				}
				else if (num <= 0m)
				{
					MessageBox.Show("برجاء إدخال كمية أكبر من الصفر");
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle = ((RowEventArgs)e).RowHandle;
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedColumn = ((ColumnView)gridView1).VisibleColumns[3];
					((BaseView)gridView1).ShowEditor();
				}
			}
		}
		Cal_FinalResultTotals();
	}

	private void gridView1_InvalidRowException(object sender, InvalidRowExceptionEventArgs e)
	{
		((ExceptionEventArgs)e).ExceptionMode = (ExceptionMode)2;
		gridControl1.DataSource = datatable;
		((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedColumn = ((ColumnView)gridView1).VisibleColumns[0];
	}

	private void gridView1_CellValueChanged(object sender, CellValueChangedEventArgs e)
	{
		if (e.Column.FieldName == "الكمية")
		{
			string value = Convert.ToString(e.Value);
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("كود_الصنف");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText2 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("الوحدة");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText3 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("أسم_الوحدة");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText4 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("م");
			if (focusedRowCellDisplayText != "")
			{
				Get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result = ITM.GetItemByCode(focusedRowCellDisplayText).FirstOrDefault();
				if (get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result != null)
				{
					foreach (DataRow row in datatable.Rows)
					{
						if (!(row["م"].ToString() == focusedRowCellDisplayText4))
						{
							continue;
						}
						decimal value2 = Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعر الوحدة"].ToString());
						row["اجمالي_متوسط_التكلفة"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["متوسط_التكلفة"]) * Convert.ToDecimal(row["الكمية"]), DecimalNum);
						row["TaxTobacco"] = Convert.ToDecimal(row["سعر الوحدة"]) * Convert.ToDecimal(get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Tobacco) / 100m;
						decimal num = Convert.ToDecimal(row["TaxTobacco"]);
						if (num < LoginDetails.MinTobaccoTax && num != 0m)
						{
							row["TaxTobacco"] = LoginDetails.MinTobaccoTax;
						}
						row["TaxTobacco"] = Convert.ToDecimal(row["TaxTobacco"]) * Convert.ToDecimal(value);
						row["TaxTobaccoDis"] = row["TaxTobacco"];
						decimal value3 = Convert.ToDecimal(value2) * Convert.ToDecimal(value);
						row["الاجمالى"] = Convert.ToDecimal(value3) + Convert.ToDecimal(row["TaxTobacco"]);
						if (ORD.IsVatActive())
						{
							if (get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Is_Tax == true)
							{
								row["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"]) * (Convert.ToDecimal(get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value / (decimal?)100) + 1m), 2);
								row["الضربية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["إجمالى المبلغ"]) - Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
								row["هل_ضريبة"] = 1;
								row["قيمة_الضريبة"] = get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value;
							}
							else
							{
								row["الضربية"] = 0;
								row["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
								row["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
								row["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							row["الضربية"] = 0;
							row["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
							row["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
							row["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
						}
					}
					insertnewrow();
					CheckFfistRow();
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle = e.RowHandle;
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedColumn = ((ColumnView)gridView1).VisibleColumns[3];
					((BaseView)gridView1).ShowEditor();
				}
			}
		}

								row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 1;
								row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result2.Tax_Value;
							}
							else
							{
								row2["الضربية"] = 0;
								row2["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
								row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
								row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							row2["الضربية"] = 0;
							row2["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
							row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
							row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
						}
						break;
					}
					insertnewrow();
					CheckFfistRow();
					GetTotalCost();
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle = e.RowHandle;
					((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedColumn = ((ColumnView)gridView1).VisibleColumns[3];
					((BaseView)gridView1).ShowEditor();
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (!(e.Column.FieldName == "إجمالى المبلغ"))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = Convert.ToString(e.Value);
		}
		ArrangeDatatable();
		Cal_FinalResultTotals();
	}

	public void SearchItems2(int RowId, int ItemIDADD)
	{
		try
		{
			LoginDetails.ItemSearch = CodeItm;
			LoginDetails.ISCheckSearchItem = false;
			LoginDetails.ISPurches = true;
			FrmSearchAdds frmSearchAdds = new FrmSearchAdds();
			((Form)(object)frmSearchAdds).ShowDialog();
			if (LoginDetails.ItemSearchAll2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (LoginDetails.ItemSearchAll2.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (string item in LoginDetails.ItemSearchAll2)
				{
					int ItemCodeRow = Convert.ToInt32(item);
					Item_Add item_Add = ((IQueryable<Item_Add>)db.Item_Add).Where((Item_Add x) => x.ID == ItemCodeRow).FirstOrDefault();
					if (item_Add != null)
					{
						DataRow dataRow = null;
						dataRow = datatable.NewRow();
						dataRow["م"] = RowId;
						dataRow["RowId"] = RowId;
						dataRow["ADDId"] = Convert.ToInt32(item_Add.ID);
						dataRow["ItemID"] = 0;
						dataRow["ItemIDADD"] = ItemIDADD;
						dataRow["ItemUnitID"] = 1;
						dataRow["كود_الصنف"] = item_Add.ID;
						dataRow["أسم الصنف"] = item_Add.Name;
						dataRow["المجموعة"] = item_Add.ID;
						dataRow["الوحدة"] = "حبة";
						dataRow["الكمية"] = 1;
						dataRow["متوسط_التكلفة"] = item_Add.CostPrice;
						dataRow["اجمالي_متوسط_التكلفة"] = item_Add.CostPrice;
						dataRow["المخزن"] = ORD.GetStoreName();
						dataRow["رقم المخزن"] = ORD.GetStoreID();
						dataRow["أسم_الوحدة"] = "الصغرى";
						dataRow["سعر الوحدة"] = item_Add.SellPrice;
						dataRow["الاجمالى"] = item_Add.SellPrice;
						if (ORD.IsVatActive())
						{
							if (item_Add.Is_Tax == true && !LoginDetails.ItemTotalWithVat)
							{
								dataRow["الضربية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item_Add.SellPrice * (decimal?)Convert.ToInt32(1) * item_Add.Tax_Value / (decimal?)100), DecimalNum);
								dataRow["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item_Add.SellPrice * (decimal?)Convert.ToInt32(1) * item_Add.Tax_Value / (decimal?)100 + (decimal?)Convert.ToDecimal(item_Add.SellPrice * (decimal?)Convert.ToInt32(1))), DecimalNum);
								dataRow["هل_ضريبة"] = 1;
								dataRow["قيمة_الضريبة"] = item_Add.Tax_Value;
							}
							else
							{
								dataRow["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
								dataRow["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
								dataRow["الضربية"] = 0.0;
								dataRow["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(Convert.ToDecimal(item_Add.SellPrice * (decimal?)Convert.ToInt32(1))), DecimalNum);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							dataRow["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
							dataRow["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
							dataRow["الضربية"] = 0.0;
							dataRow["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(Convert.ToDecimal(item_Add.SellPrice * (decimal?)Convert.ToInt32(1))), DecimalNum);
						}
						object obj = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetDataSourceRowIndex(((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle);
						int num = Convert.ToInt32(obj.ToString());
						datatable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
					}
					IsShow = 1;
				}
				GetTotalCost();
				ArrangeDatatable();
				((Form)(object)frmSearchAdds).Close();
				((Control)(object)frmSearchAdds).Hide();
				LoginDetails.ItemSearchAll2.Clear();
				LoginDetails.ISPurches = false;
			}
			((Form)(object)frmSearchAdds).Close();
			((Control)(object)frmSearchAdds).Hide();
			LoginDetails.ItemSearchAll2.Clear();
			LoginDetails.ISCheckSearchItem = true;
			LoginDetails.ISPurches = false;
			Cal_FinalResultTotals();
			gridControl1.DataSource = datatable;
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Clear();
			Cal_FinalResultTotals();
			LoginDetails.ISCheckSearchItem = true;
			LoginDetails.ISPurches = false;
		}
	}

	private void BtnPrint_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		if (!(((Control)(object)TxtCode).Text != ""))
		{
			return;
		}
		FrmPrint frmPrint = new FrmPrint();
		((Form)(object)frmPrint).ShowDialog();
		if (frmPrint.CKCust.Checked)
		{
			Thread thread = new Thread(() =>
			{
				((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)(Action)(() =>
				{
					Print(Code);
				}));
			});
			thread.Start();
		}
		if (frmPrint.CKRest.Checked)
		{
			Thread thread2 = new Thread(() =>
			{
				((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)(Action)(() =>
				{
					PrintSecondCasheir(Code);
				}));
			});
			thread2.Start();
		}
		if (!frmPrint.CKCustPrintSecond.Checked)
		{
			return;
		}
		Thread thread3 = new Thread(() =>
		{
			((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)(Action)(() =>
			{
				PrintSecondDefualt(Code);
			}));
		});
		thread3.Start();
	}

	private void TxtCode_ButtonClick(object sender, ButtonPressedEventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			FrmSearchOrders frmSearchOrders = new FrmSearchOrders();
			((Form)(object)frmSearchOrders).ShowDialog();
			if (frmSearchOrders.CustCode > 0)
			{
				int custCode = frmSearchOrders.CustCode;
				Order_Orders order_Orders = ORD.GetPurchases(custCode).FirstOrDefault();
				datatable.Rows.Clear();
				List<Order_OrdersDetails> itemsPurchesByID = ORD.GetItemsPurchesByID(custCode);
				int num = 1;
				foreach (Order_OrdersDetails item in itemsPurchesByID)
				{
					DataRow dataRow = null;
					int ItemAdd = 0;
					int num2 = Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemID);
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						num2 = Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemIDADD);
						ItemAdd = Convert.ToInt32(item.R_ADDId);
					}
					Item_Items item_Items = ORD.GetItemsByitemid(num2).FirstOrDefault();
					Printer printer = ORD.GetPrinter(num2);
					dataRow = datatable.NewRow();
					dataRow["م"] = Convert.ToInt32(item.R_ItmSN);
					dataRow["RowId"] = Convert.ToInt32(item.R_RowId);
					dataRow["ADDId"] = Convert.ToInt32(item.R_ADDId);
					dataRow["ItemID"] = Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.ItemId);
					dataRow["ItemIDADD"] = Convert.ToInt32(item.ItemIDADD);
					dataRow["ItemUnitID"] = Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.UnitSmall);
					dataRow["PrinterID"] = printer.ID;
					dataRow["PrinterName"] = printer.Name;
					dataRow["PrinterIDItem"] = item_Items.PrinterID;
					dataRow["PrinterNameItem"] = ORD.GetPrinterName(Convert.ToInt32(item_Items.PrinterID));
					dataRow["المجموعة"] = item_Items.Category_ID;
					if (ItemAdd > 0)
					{
						dataRow["كود_الصنف"] = ItemAdd;
						dataRow["أسم الصنف"] = ((IQueryable<Item_Add>)db.Item_Add).Where((Item_Add x) => x.ID == ItemAdd).FirstOrDefault().Name;
						dataRow["الاسم الانجليزي"] = dataRow["أسم الصنف"];
					}
					else
					{
						dataRow["كود_الصنف"] = item_Items.Item_code;
						dataRow["أسم الصنف"] = item_Items.item_Name;
						dataRow["الاسم الانجليزي"] = item_Items.item_Name_English;
					}
					if (item.ItemUnitType == "الصغرى")
					{
						dataRow["الوحدة"] = ((IQueryable<Item_Unit>)db.Item_Unit).Where((Item_Unit x) => (int?)x.ID == item.ItemUnitID).FirstOrDefault().Name;
					}
					if (item.ItemUnitType == "المتوسطة")
					{
						dataRow["الوحدة"] = ((IQueryable<Item_Unit>)db.Item_Unit).Where((Item_Unit x) => (int?)x.ID == item.ItemUnitID).FirstOrDefault().Name;
					}
					if (item.ItemUnitType == "الكبرى")
					{
						dataRow["الوحدة"] = ((IQueryable<Item_Unit>)db.Item_Unit).Where((Item_Unit x) => (int?)x.ID == item.ItemUnitID).FirstOrDefault().Name;
					}
					dataRow["أسم_الوحدة"] = item.ItemUnitType;
					dataRow["رقم المخزن"] = item.StoreID;
					dataRow["المخزن"] = (from x in (IQueryable<Account_Stores>)db.Account_Stores
						where (int?)x.ID == item.StoreID
						select x.Store_Name).FirstOrDefault();
					dataRow["الكمية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.Quantity), DecimalNum);
					dataRow["سعر الوحدة"] = item.UnitPrice;
					dataRow["متوسط_التكلفة"] = item.LastCost;
					dataRow["اجمالي_متوسط_التكلفة"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(dataRow["متوسط_التكلفة"]) * Convert.ToDecimal(dataRow["الكمية"]), DecimalNum);
					dataRow["الاجمالى"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.TotalPrice), DecimalNum);
					dataRow["مسح"] = 0;
					dataRow["الطول"] = 1;
					dataRow["العرض"] = 1;
					dataRow["الإرتفاع"] = 1;
					dataRow["الوزن"] = 1;
					dataRow["قيمة الخصم"] = 0;
					dataRow["نسبةالخصم"] = 0;
					dataRow["TaxTobacco"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.TobaccoTax), DecimalNum);
					dataRow["TaxTobaccoDis"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.TobaccoTaxDis), DecimalNum);
					decimal? vAT = item.VAT;
					if ((vAT.GetValueOrDefault() > 0m) & vAT.HasValue)
					{
						dataRow["الضربية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.VAT), DecimalNum);
						dataRow["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.NetTotalPrice), DecimalNum);
						dataRow["هل_ضريبة"] = 1;
						dataRow["قيمة_الضريبة"] = item_Items.Tax_Value;
					}
					else
					{
						dataRow["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
						dataRow["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
						dataRow["الضربية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.VAT), DecimalNum);
						dataRow["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(item.NetTotalPrice) + Convert.ToDecimal(item.VAT), DecimalNum);
					}
					datatable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
					num++;
				}
				gridControl1.DataSource = datatable;
				((Control)(object)TxtCode).Text = order_Orders.PurBranchID.ToString();
				Code = custCode;
				((Control)(object)TxtPhone).Text = order_Orders.SupplierPhone;
				TxtDate.DateTime = Convert.ToDateTime(order_Orders.Purchases_Date);
				((Control)(object)TxtTotals).Text = Convert.ToString(order_Orders.TotalPrices);
				((Control)(object)TxtVat).Text = Convert.ToString(order_Orders.Tax);
				((Control)(object)TxtTotalAll).Text = order_Orders.Safy.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtDiscount).Text = order_Orders.DiscountNum.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtTotalBeforDisc).Text = order_Orders.TotalPrices_Discount.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtVatBeforeDisc).Text = order_Orders.Tax_Discount.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtNet).Text = order_Orders.Net.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtNet22).Text = order_Orders.Safy.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtCost).Text = order_Orders.CostOrder.ToString();
				Cash = Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.CashMoney);
				Bank = Convert.ToDecimal(order_Orders.CashBank);
				((Control)(object)TxtTabocc).Text = order_Orders.TobaccoTax.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtAllVat).Text = order_Orders.AllTax.ToString();
				LoginDetails.NetCash = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(((Control)(object)TxtNet).Text), DecimalNum);
				LoginDetails.VatCash = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(((Control)(object)TxtVatBeforeDisc).Text), DecimalNum);
				if (order_Orders.Restaurant_TypeID == 1)
				{
					ReturantType = "طلب سفري";
				}
				if (order_Orders.Restaurant_TypeID == 2)
				{
					ReturantType = "طلب محلي";
				}
				if (order_Orders.Restaurant_TypeID == 3)
				{
					ReturantType = "طلب توصيل";
				}
				((Control)(object)BtnSave).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)BtnSaveMahly).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)BtnSaveTawsel).Enabled = false;
				((Control)(object)BtnDelete).Enabled = true;
				((ColumnViewOptionsBehavior)gridView1.OptionsBehavior).Editable = true;
				ArrangeDatatable();
				IsEnableFalse();
			}
			GetElctornc();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Clear();
		}
	}

	public void UpdateUnitPriceInGrid(CellValueChangedEventArgs e)
	{
		int num = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetDataSourceRowIndex(((ColumnView)gridView1).FocusedRowHandle) + 1;
		foreach (DataRow row in datatable.Rows)
		{
			if (!(row["م"].ToString() == Convert.ToString(num)))
			{
				continue;
			}
			string value = Convert.ToString(e.Value);
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("كود_الصنف");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText2 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("الوحدة");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText3 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("أسم_الوحدة");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText4 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("الكمية");
			string focusedRowCellDisplayText5 = ((ColumnView)gridView1).GetFocusedRowCellDisplayText("م");
			if (!(focusedRowCellDisplayText != ""))
			{
				break;
			}
			Get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result = ITM.GetItemByCode(focusedRowCellDisplayText).FirstOrDefault();
			if (get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result == null)
			{
				break;
			}
			foreach (DataRow row2 in datatable.Rows)
			{
				if (!(row2["م"].ToString() == focusedRowCellDisplayText5))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (row2["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString() == "الصغرى")
				{
					decimal sellPermission = ORD.GetSellPermission(focusedRowCellDisplayText, UserSellPrice, "الصغرى");
					if (UserSellPrice == 1)
					{
						if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission)
						{
							MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر بيع القطاعي", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
							row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (UserSellPrice == 2)
					{
						if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission)
						{
							MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر بيع الجملة", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
							row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (UserSellPrice == 3)
					{
						if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission)
						{
							MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر بيع جملة الجملة", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
							row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (UserSellPrice == 4 && Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission)
					{
						MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر الشراء", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
						row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission;
						return;
					}
					if (LoginDetails.ItemTotalWithVat)
					{
						row2["سعر الوحدة"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(value) / (Convert.ToDecimal(get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value / (decimal?)100) + 1m), 2);
					}
					else
					{
						row2["سعر الوحدة"] = value;
					}
					row2["TaxTobacco"] = Convert.ToDecimal(value) * Convert.ToDecimal(get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Tobacco) / 100m;
					decimal num2 = Convert.ToDecimal(row2["TaxTobacco"]);
					if (num2 < LoginDetails.MinTobaccoTax && num2 != 0m)
					{
						row2["TaxTobacco"] = LoginDetails.MinTobaccoTax;
					}
					row2["TaxTobacco"] = Convert.ToDecimal(row2["TaxTobacco"]) * Convert.ToDecimal(focusedRowCellDisplayText4);
					row2["TaxTobaccoDis"] = row2["TaxTobacco"];
					decimal value2 = Convert.ToDecimal(value) * Convert.ToDecimal(focusedRowCellDisplayText4);
					row2["الاجمالى"] = Convert.ToDecimal(value2) + Convert.ToDecimal(row2["TaxTobacco"]);
					if (ORD.IsVatActive())
					{
						if (get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Is_Tax == true)
						{
							if (LoginDetails.ItemTotalWithVat)
							{
								row2["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]), 2);
								row2["الضربية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["إجمالى المبلغ"]) * Convert.ToDecimal(get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value / (decimal?)100), DecimalNum);
								row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 1;
								row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value;
							}
							else
							{
								row2["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]) * (Convert.ToDecimal(get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value / (decimal?)100) + 1m), 2);
								row2["الضربية"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["إجمالى المبلغ"]) - Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
								row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 1;
								row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = get_Item_ByCodeALL_Result.Tax_Value;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							row2["الضربية"] = 0;
							row2["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
							row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
							row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						row2["الضربية"] = 0;
						row2["إجمالى المبلغ"] = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(row2["الاجمالى"]), DecimalNum);
						row2["هل_ضريبة"] = 0;
						row2["قيمة_الضريبة"] = 0;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (row2["أسم_الوحدة"].ToString() == "المتوسطة")
				{
					decimal sellPermission2 = ORD.GetSellPermission(focusedRowCellDisplayText, UserSellPrice, "المتوسطة");
					if (UserSellPrice == 1)
					{
						if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission2)
						{
							MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر بيع القطاعي", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
							row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission2;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (UserSellPrice == 2)
					{
						if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission2)
						{
							MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر بيع الجملة", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
							row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission2;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (UserSellPrice == 3)
					{
						if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission2)
						{
							MessageBox.Show("عفوا\u064b لا يمكن بيع هذا الصنف بسعر اقل من سعر بيع جملة الجملة", "صلاحيات المبيعات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
							row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission2;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (UserSellPrice == 4 && Convert.ToDecimal(value) < sellPermission2)
					{

						row2["سعر الوحدة"] = sellPermission2;
