	private void Save()
	{
		if (CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 41))
		{
			int num = 0;
			int TxtCode = 0;
			if (TxtNet.Text != "" && Convert.ToDecimal(TxtNet.Text) >= 0m && ((Control)(object)TxtAccount).Text != "")
			{
				string value = DateTime.Now.ToShortDateString();
				num = Daily.InsertTran(out var TRNCode, out TxtCode, "", Convert.ToDateTime(value), "قيد اغلاق حركة يومية من فترة " + ((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " الي فترة " + ((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				num = Daily.InsertItems(TRNCode, Convert.ToInt32(LblAccount.Text), Convert.ToInt32(LblAccountbox.Text), "قيد اغلاق حركة يومية من فترة " + ((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " الي فترة " + ((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text, Convert.ToDecimal(TxtNet.Text), 0, IsEdit: false, 0);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					MessageBox.Show("تم حفظ قيد اغلاق حركة يومية بنجاح", "نجاح الاغلاق", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				}
			}
			else if (Convert.ToDecimal(TxtNet.Text) == 0m)
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لم يتم الحفظ، لعدم توفر نقود في الصندوق النقدي ", "المستكشف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			}
			else if (((Control)(object)TxtAccount).Text == "")
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لم يتم الحفظ، من فضلك اختار حساب الايداع ثم حاول مرة اخري ", "المستكشف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				((Control)(object)TxtAccount).Focus();
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لم يتم الحفظ ", "المستكشف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	private void Search()
	{
		//IL_042a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0431: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		try
		{
			if (CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 41))
			{
				if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "" && ((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text != "")
				{
					if (TxtDate1.DateTime <= TxtDate2.DateTime)
					{
						SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
						ST.Tables["MovementsDailyReport"].Clear();
						SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_MovementsDailyReportCloseDay", sqlConnection);
						sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
						SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
						sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text));
						sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text));
						sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", LoginDetails.BranchID);
						sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserID", LoginDetails.UserID);
						sqlDataAdapter.Fill(ST.MovementsDailyReport);
						sqlConnection.Close();
						if (ST.Tables["MovementsDailyReport"].Rows.Count > 0)
						{
							DataSetALL.MovementsDailyReportRow movementsDailyReportRow = ST.MovementsDailyReport.FirstOrDefault();
							TxtOrdCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalOrderCash;
							TxtOrdRTNCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalOrderCashReturn;
							TxtOrdNetCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.NetOrderCash;
							TxtOrdAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalOrderAjil;
							TxtOrdRTNAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalOrderAjilReturn;
							TxtOrdNetAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.NetOrderAjil;
							TxtPurchCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalPurshesCash;
							TxtPurchRtnCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalPurshesCashReturn;
							TxtPurchNetCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.NetPurshesCash;
							TxtPurchAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalPurshesAjil;
							TxtPurchRtnAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalPurshesAjilReturn;
							TxtPurchNetAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.NetPurshesAjil;
							TxtTransferToCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TransferToBranchCash;
							TxtTransferToAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TransferToBranchAjil;
							TxtTransferFromCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TransferFromBranchCash;
							TxtTransferFromAjil.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TransferFromBranchAjil;
							TxtCash.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.CashMoney;
							TxtBank.Text = (Convert.ToDecimal(movementsDailyReportRow.TotalOrderCash) - Convert.ToDecimal(movementsDailyReportRow.CashMoney)).ToString();
							TxtIncome.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalRecipt;
							TxtExpenses.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.TotalPayment;
							TxtIncomeNet.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.NetRecipt;
							TxtExpensesNet.Text = movementsDailyReportRow.NetPayment;
							TxtSafyWithoutOpenMoney.Text = Convert.ToDecimal(movementsDailyReportRow.Safy).ToString();
							TxtNet.Text = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(TxtCash.Text), 2).ToString();
							ToWord toWord = new ToWord(Convert.ToDecimal(TxtNet.Text), currencies[tafqitID]);
							txtWordAr = toWord.ConvertToArabic();
							StiReport val = new StiReport();
							LblTafqit.Text = txtWordAr;
						}
						else
						{
							MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة ", "المستكشف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						MessageBox.Show("لا يمكن ان يكون التاريخ الاول اكبر من التاريخ الثاني ", "المستكشف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
						((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Focus();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					MessageBox.Show("لا يمكن ان يكون التاريخ فارغ ", "المستكشف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
					if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
					{
						((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text = DateTime.Now.ToShortDateString();
						((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Focus();
					}
					else if (((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text != "")
					{
						((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text = DateTime.Now.ToShortDateString();
						((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Focus();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	private void insertDayClose()
	{
		int num = 0;
		GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
		try
		{
			User_DayClose user_DayClose = new User_DayClose();
			user_DayClose.UserID = LoginDetails.UserID;
			user_DayClose.UserName = LoginDetails.UserName;
			user_DayClose.DateOpen = TxtDate1.DateTime;
			user_DayClose.DateClose = TxtDate2.DateTime;
			user_DayClose.TotalOrderCash = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtOrdCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalOrderCashReturn = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtOrdRTNCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.NetOrderCash = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtOrdNetCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalOrderAjil = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtOrdAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalOrderAjilReturn = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtOrdRTNAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.NetOrderAjil = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtOrdNetAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalPurshesCash = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtPurchCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalPurshesCashReturn = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtPurchRtnCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.NetPurshesCash = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtPurchNetCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalPurshesAjil = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtPurchAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalPurshesAjilReturn = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtPurchRtnAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.NetPurshesAjil = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtPurchNetAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.TransferToBranchCash = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtTransferToCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.TransferToBranchAjil = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtTransferToAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.TransferFromBranchCash = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtTransferFromCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.TransferFromBranchAjil = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtTransferFromAjil.Text);
			user_DayClose.CashMoney = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtCash.Text);
			user_DayClose.CashBank = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtBank.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalRecipt = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtIncome.Text);
			user_DayClose.TotalPayment = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtExpenses.Text);
			user_DayClose.NetRecipt = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtIncomeNet.Text);
			user_DayClose.NetPayment = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtExpensesNet.Text);
			user_DayClose.SafyWithoutOpenMoney = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtSafyWithoutOpenMoney.Text);
			user_DayClose.Safy = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtNet.Text);
			user_DayClose.MoneyOpen = Convert.ToDecimal(TxtMoneyOpen.Text);
			gTSdbEntities.User_DayClose.Add(user_DayClose);
			num = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
		}
		finally
		{
			((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
		}
	}

	private void Bind()
	{
		GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
		try
		{
			User_Login user_Login = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)gTSdbEntities.User_Login).Where((User_Login x) => x.ID == LoginDetails.UserID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (user_Login != null)
			{
				LblUser.Text = LoginDetails.UserName;
				TxtMoneyOpen.Text = Math.Round(user_Login.MoneyOpenDay.Value, 2).ToString();
				TxtNote.Text = user_Login.Note;
				RBIsOpen.IsOn = Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsOpenDay);
				TxtDate1.DateTime = Convert.ToDateTime(user_Login.DateOpen);
				TxtDate2.DateTime = DateTime.Now;
				if (Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsOpenDay))
				{
					TxtNet.ReadOnly = true;
					IsClose = Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsOpenDay);
				}
				Search();
			}
		}
		finally
		{
			((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
		}
	}

	private int CloseDay()
	{
		int result = 0;
		GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
		try
		{
			User_Login user_Login = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)gTSdbEntities.User_Login).Where((User_Login x) => x.ID == LoginDetails.UserID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (user_Login != null)
			{
				user_Login.MoneyOpenDay = 0m;
				user_Login.IsOpenDay = false;
				user_Login.Note = "";
				result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
			}
		}
		finally
		{
			((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
		}
		return result;
	}

		}
		((XtraForm)this).Dispose(disposing);
	}

using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data.Entity;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using DevExpress.Utils;
using DevExpress.XtraEditors;
using DevExpress.XtraEditors.Controls;
using DevExpress.XtraEditors.Repository;
using GTSErpSystem.Frms.Orders.FrmLuckUpOrders;
using Janus.Windows.GridEX;
using Janus.Windows.GridEX.EditControls;

namespace GTSErpSystem.Frms.Orders.FrmOpenDay;

public class FrmOpenDay : XtraForm
{
	public bool ISOpen = false;

	private IContainer components = null;

	private GroupBox group;

	private TextBox TxtNote;

	private Label label3;

	private Label label2;

	private NumericEditBox TxtNet;

	private TextBox TxtName;

	private Label label1;

	private Label LblID;

	private ToggleSwitch RBIsOpen;

	private SimpleButton BtnExit;

	private SimpleButton BtnSave;

	private DateEdit TxtDate;

	public FrmOpenDay()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		Bind();
	}

	private void Bind()
	{
		GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
		try
		{
			User_Login user_Login = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)gTSdbEntities.User_Login).Where((User_Login x) => x.ID == LoginDetails.UserID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (user_Login != null)
			{
				TxtName.Text = LoginDetails.UserName;
				LblID.Text = LoginDetails.UserID.ToString();
				((Control)(object)TxtNet).Text = user_Login.MoneyOpenDay.ToString();
				TxtNote.Text = user_Login.Note;
				RBIsOpen.IsOn = Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsOpenDay);
				TxtDate.DateTime = DateTime.Now;
				if (Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsOpenDay))
				{
					group.Enabled = false;
					ISOpen = Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsOpenDay);
				}
			}
		}
		finally
		{
			((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
		}
	}

	private int Save(int ID, decimal MoneyOpenDay, string Note, DateTime Date)
	{
		int result = 0;
		GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
		try
		{
			User_Login user_Login = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)gTSdbEntities.User_Login).Where((User_Login x) => x.ID == ID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (user_Login != null)
			{
				user_Login.MoneyOpenDay = MoneyOpenDay;
				user_Login.IsOpenDay = true;
				user_Login.Note = Note;
				user_Login.DateOpen = Date;
				result = ((DbContext)gTSdbEntities).SaveChanges();
			}
		}
		finally
		{
			((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
		}
		return result;
	}

	private void BtnSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		FrmPassWordSupervisor frmPassWordSupervisor = new FrmPassWordSupervisor();

	public FrmNetOrders()
	{

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02bb: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 54))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_OrdersNet_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldOdersNet.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldOdersNet.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));

	public FrmNetPurches()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else

			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		BindComboBox();
		((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1).ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");
		((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");

		((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text = "23:59:59";

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02bb: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 54))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_PurchasesNet_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldPurchesNet.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldPurchesNet.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_AccountType item in ORD.GetAccountType().ToList())
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
			dataRow.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dataTable.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow, 0);

			TxtType.DisplayMember = "Name";

			dtCus.Columns.Add("CustSuppName", typeof(string));
			dtCus.Columns.Add("AccountID", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_CustSup item2 in (from x in Cus.GetAll()
				where x.IsCustomers == true
				select x).ToList())

				dtCus.Rows.Add(item2.ID, item2.CustSuppName, item2.AccountNo);

	private void TxtCustomer_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{

	}

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02bb: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 54))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_OrdersPurchNet_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldOrdersPurchNet.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldOrdersPurchNet.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

		LblAccountID.Text = dataRow[2].ToString();
	}

	public FrmOrders()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else

			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		BindComboBox();
		((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1).ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02bb: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 54))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_Orders_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldOders.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldOders.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_AccountType item in ORD.GetAccountType().ToList())
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
			dataRow.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dataTable.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow, 0);
			TxtType.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtType.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtType.DataSource = dataTable;
			TxtType.SelectedValue = 0;
			dtCus = new DataTable();
			dtCus.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dtCus.Columns.Add("CustSuppName", typeof(string));
			dtCus.Columns.Add("AccountID", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_CustSup item2 in (from x in Cus.GetAll()
				where x.IsCustomers == true
				select x).ToList())
			{
				dtCus.Rows.Add(item2.ID, item2.CustSuppName, item2.AccountNo);
			}
			DataRow dataRow2 = dtCus.NewRow();
			dataRow2.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dtCus.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow2, 0);
			TxtCustomer.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtCustomer.DisplayMember = "CustSuppName";
			TxtCustomer.DataSource = dtCus;
			TxtCustomer.SelectedValue = 0;
			dtStore = new DataTable();
			dtStore.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dtStore.Columns.Add("Store_Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_Stores item3 in stores.GetAll().ToList())
			{
				dtStore.Rows.Add(item3.ID, item3.Store_Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow3 = dtStore.NewRow();
			dataRow3.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dtStore.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow3, 0);
			TxtStore.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtStore.DisplayMember = "Store_Name";
			TxtStore.DataSource = dtStore;
			TxtStore.SelectedValue = 0;
			DataTable dataTable2 = new DataTable();
			dataTable2.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable2.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Item_Class item4 in ((IEnumerable<Item_Class>)db.Item_Class).ToList())
			{
				dataTable2.Rows.Add(item4.ID, item4.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow4 = dataTable2.NewRow();
			dataRow4.ItemArray = new object[2] { -1, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dataTable2.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow4, 0);
			TxtClass.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtClass.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtClass.DataSource = dataTable2;
			TxtClass.SelectedValue = -1;
			DataTable dataTable3 = new DataTable();
			dataTable3.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable3.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Item_Groups item5 in ((IEnumerable<Item_Groups>)db.Item_Groups).ToList())
			{
				dataTable3.Rows.Add(item5.ID, item5.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow5 = dataTable3.NewRow();
			dataRow5.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dataTable3.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow5, 0);
			TxtGroup.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtGroup.DisplayMember = "Name";

			TxtGroup.SelectedValue = 0;
			DataTable dataTable4 = new DataTable();

			dataTable4.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Item_Company item6 in ((IEnumerable<Item_Company>)db.Item_Company).ToList())
			{
				dataTable4.Rows.Add(item6.ID, item6.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow6 = dataTable4.NewRow();
			dataRow6.ItemArray = new object[2] { -1, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dataTable4.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow6, 0);
			TxtCompany.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtCompany.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtCompany.DataSource = dataTable4;
			TxtCompany.SelectedValue = -1;
			DataTable dataTable5 = new DataTable();
			dataTable5.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable5.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (User_Login item7 in ((IEnumerable<User_Login>)db.User_Login).ToList())
			{
				dataTable5.Rows.Add(item7.ID, item7.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow7 = dataTable5.NewRow();

		}

		}
	}

	public FrmOrdersNetPurchOnly()
	{

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02be: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 155))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_OrdersNetPurchOnly_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldOrdersNetPurchOnly.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldOrdersNetPurchOnly.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_AccountType item in ORD.GetAccountType().ToList())
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
			dataRow.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dataTable.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow, 0);
			TxtType.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtType.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtType.DataSource = dataTable;
			TxtType.SelectedValue = 0;
			dtCus = new DataTable();
			dtCus.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dtCus.Columns.Add("CustSuppName", typeof(string));
			dtCus.Columns.Add("AccountID", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_CustSup item2 in (from x in Cus.GetAll()
				where x.IsCustomers == true
				select x).ToList())
			{
				dtCus.Rows.Add(item2.ID, item2.CustSuppName, item2.AccountNo);
			}
			DataRow dataRow2 = dtCus.NewRow();
			dataRow2.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الـــــكـــــل" };
			dtCus.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow2, 0);
			TxtCustomer.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtCustomer.DisplayMember = "CustSuppName";
			TxtCustomer.DataSource = dtCus;
			TxtCustomer.SelectedValue = 0;
			dtStore = new DataTable();
			dtStore.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dtStore.Columns.Add("Store_Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_Stores item3 in stores.GetAll().ToList())
			{
				dtStore.Rows.Add(item3.ID, item3.Store_Name);

	public FrmOrdersReturn()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		BindComboBox();
		((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1).ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");
		((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");

		((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text = "23:59:59";

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02bb: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 54))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_OrdersReturn_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldOderReturn.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldOderReturn.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try

	public FrmPurches()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}

			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");

		InitializeComponent();
		BindComboBox();
		((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1).ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");
		((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_02b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_02bb: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 54))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_Purches_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldPurches.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldPurches.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_AccountType item in ORD.GetAccountType().ToList())
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name);
			}

	}

		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_PurchesReturn_ByProperties", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StoreId", Convert.ToInt32(TxtStore.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportGoldPurchesReturn.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportGoldPurchesReturn.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportGoldenORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text);
				val["Date2"] = Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text);
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public FrmAllOrdersDetailsByProperties()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		BindComboBox();
		((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1).ToShortDateString();
		((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd");

		((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text = "23:59:59";

	private void BtnContinue_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		//IL_028d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0294: Expected Obj, but got Unknown
		if (!CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 115))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportORD_PURDetails"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("GetReport_OrderDetailsByCatogry", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CashType", Convert.ToInt32(TxtType.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BranchID", Convert.ToInt32(LoginDetails.BranchID));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CustID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCustomer.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EmpID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtEmployyee.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroup.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ClassID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtClass.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CompanyID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtCompany.SelectedValue));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date1", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text));
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date2", Convert.ToDateTime(((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.GetReportORD_PURDetails);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["GetReportORD_PURDetails"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportALLOdersDetailsByProperties.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportALLOdersDetailsByProperties.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.GetReportORD_PURDetails);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["Date1"] = ((Control)(object)TxtDate1).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime1).Text;
				val["Date2"] = ((Control)(object)TxtDate2).Text + " " + ((Control)(object)TxtTime2).Text;
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_AccountType item in ORD.GetAccountType().ToList())
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name);
			}
			DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
			dataRow.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "الكل" };
			dataTable.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow, 0);
			TxtType.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtType.DisplayMember = "Name";
			TxtType.DataSource = dataTable;
			TxtType.SelectedValue = 0;
			DataTable dataTable2 = new DataTable();
			dataTable2.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
			dataTable2.Columns.Add("CustSuppName", typeof(string));
			foreach (Account_CustSup item2 in (from x in Cus.GetAll()
				where x.IsCustomers == true
				select x).ToList())
			{
				dataTable2.Rows.Add(item2.ID, item2.CustSuppName);
			}
			DataRow dataRow2 = dataTable2.NewRow();
			dataRow2.ItemArray = new object[2] { -1, "الكل" };
			dataTable2.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow2, 0);
			TxtCustomer.ValueMember = "ID";
			TxtCustomer.DisplayMember = "CustSuppName";
			TxtCustomer.DataSource = dataTable2;
			TxtCustomer.SelectedValue = -1;
			DataTable dataTable3 = new DataTable();

			dataTable3.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
			foreach (User_Login item3 in ((IEnumerable<User_Login>)DBR.User_Login).ToList())

			}
			DataRow dataRow3 = dataTable3.NewRow();

			foreach (Item_Groups item4 in ((IEnumerable<Item_Groups>)DBR.Item_Groups).ToList())

			}
			DataRow dataRow4 = dataTable4.NewRow();

		if (TxtUser.Text != "")
		{
			SqlConnection sqlConnection = new SqlConnection("Data Source=" + Server + ";Initial Catalog=" + dataServer + ";Persist Security Info=True;User ID=" + userserver + ";Password=" + passServer);
			DataSetALL dataSetALL = new DataSetALL();
			dataSetALL.Tables["TableCloseDayByUser"].Clear();
			SqlCommand sqlCommand = new SqlCommand("Report_CloseDayByUser", sqlConnection);
			sqlCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			SqlDataAdapter sqlDataAdapter = new SqlDataAdapter(sqlCommand);
			sqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserID", Convert.ToInt32(TxtUser.SelectedValue));
			sqlDataAdapter.Fill(dataSetALL.TableCloseDayByUser);
			sqlConnection.Close();
			if (dataSetALL.Tables["TableCloseDayByUser"].Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				StiReport val = new StiReport();
				if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\Reports\\ReportCloseDayByUser.mrt");
				}
				else
				{
					val.Load(Application.StartupPath + "\\ReportsEN\\ReportCloseDayByUser.mrt");
				}
				val.RegData((DataTable)dataSetALL.TableCloseDayByUser);
				val.Dictionary.Synchronize();
				val.Compile();
				val["CompanyAr"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameAR;
				val["CompanyEn"] = LoginDetails.CompanyNameEN;
				val["VatNumComp"] = LoginDetails.VatNum;
				val["CommercialRegister"] = LoginDetails.CommercialRegister;
				val["Address"] = LoginDetails.Address;
				val["Phone"] = LoginDetails.Phone;
				val["Bank"] = LoginDetails.CompanyBank;
				val["UserName"] = TxtUser.Text;
				val.Render();
				val.Show(true);
				FrmReportGetOrder frmReportGetOrder = new FrmReportGetOrder();
				frmReportGetOrder.stiViewerControl1.Report = val;
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("لا يوجد سجلات متاحة للطباعة", "مستكشف الطباعة", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public void BindComboBox()
	{
		try
		{
			GTSdbEntities gTSdbEntities = new GTSdbEntities();
			try
			{
				DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
				List<User_Login> list = ((IEnumerable<User_Login>)gTSdbEntities.User_Login).ToList();
				dataTable.Columns.Add("ID", typeof(int));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("Name", typeof(string));
				foreach (User_Login item in list)
				{
					dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name);
				}
				DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
				dataRow.ItemArray = new object[2] { 0, "-- الكل --" };
				dataTable.Rows.InsertAt(dataRow, 0);
				TxtUser.ValueMember = "ID";
				TxtUser.DisplayMember = "Name";
				TxtUser.DataSource = dataTable;
				TxtUser.SelectedValue = 0;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)gTSdbEntities)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(ex.ToString(), "خطأ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
		}
	}

	public static InputLanguage GetInputLanguageByName(string inputName)
	{
		foreach (InputLanguage installedInputLanguage in InputLanguage.InstalledInputLanguages)
		{
			if (installedInputLanguage.Culture.EnglishName.ToLower().StartsWith(inputName))
			{
				return installedInputLanguage;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private void SetKeyboardLayout(InputLanguage layout)
	{
		InputLanguage.CurrentInputLanguage = layout;
	}

	private void BindCBBranch()

		CBUser_SellPrice.ValueMember = "ID";
		CBUser_SellPrice.SelectedValue = 1;
	}

	private void BindGrid()
	{
		gridEX1.ColumnAutoResize = true;
		DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("gridEX1");
		dataTable.Columns.Add("كود", typeof(int));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("اسم المجموعة", typeof(string));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("الفرع", typeof(string));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("SellPrice2", typeof(bool));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("SellPrice3", typeof(bool));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("LastPrice", typeof(bool));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("AvergPrice", typeof(bool));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("ProvePrice", typeof(bool));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("CBUserSellPrice", typeof(int));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("QuantityMinzero", typeof(bool));
		foreach (User_Groups allUser in USR.GetAllUsers())
		{
			dataTable.Rows.Add(allUser.ID, allUser.Name, USR.GetBranchName(Convert.ToInt32(allUser.BranchID)), allUser.SellPrice2, allUser.SellPrice3, allUser.LastPrice, allUser.AvergPrice, allUser.ProvePrice, allUser.SelectSellPrice, allUser.SelectQuantityPrice);
		}
		gridEX1.SetDataBinding((object)dataTable, "");
		gridEX1.RetrieveStructure();
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].Width = 30;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].RightToLeft = RightToLeft.No;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["اسم المجموعة"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["الفرع"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["SellPrice2"].Visible = false;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["SellPrice3"].Visible = false;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["LastPrice"].Visible = false;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["AvergPrice"].Visible = false;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["ProvePrice"].Visible = false;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["CBUserSellPrice"].Visible = false;
		gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["QuantityMinzero"].Visible = false;
	}

	public FrmSecurityGroup()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		CRTDataTablePermassions();
		BindGroups();
	}

	public void InsertPrivalge()
	{
		foreach (DataRow row in datatablePermassions.Rows)
		{
			GoupClass.InsertOnePermassion(GrpID, Convert.ToInt32(row[0].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[3].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[4].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[5].ToString()), Convert.ToBoolean(row[6].ToString()), Allow_Print: true, Allow_Export: true, LoginDetails.UserID, LoginDetails.macAddress);
		}
	}

	private void BtnSavePermission_Click_1(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		if (CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 3))
		{
			switch (MessageBox.Show("هل أنت متأكد من اضافة الصلاحيات الي المجموعة", "تأكيد الحفظ", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question))
			{
			case DialogResult.Yes:
				InsertPrivalge();
				MessageBox.Show("تم حفظ صلاحيات المجموعة بنجاح", "نجاح الحفظ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
				break;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

	public int SlECTID()
	{
		return GoupClass.SLCID();

	public void CRTDataTablePermassions()
	{
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("ScreenID", typeof(int));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("كود ", typeof(int));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("اسم الشاشة", typeof(string));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("دخول", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("حفظ", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("تعديل", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("حذف", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("طباعة", typeof(bool));
		datatablePermassions.Columns.Add("إستخراج", typeof(bool));
	}

	private void BindGroups()
	{
		TxtGroups.DataSource = GRP.GetAllUsers().ToList();
		TxtGroups.DisplayMember = "Name";
		TxtGroups.ValueMember = "ID";
	}

	public void BindGridGroupsPrlivalges(int GroupId)
	{
		datatablePermassions.Clear();
		int num = 1;
		List<User_Permission> permassionByGroupID = GoupClass.GetPermassionByGroupID(GroupId);
		foreach (User_Screens item in from x in GoupClass.GetAllGroupsPermaion()
			orderby x.ScreenNum
			orderby x.ScreenTypeID
			select x)
		{
			User_Permission user_Permission = permassionByGroupID.Where((User_Permission x) => x.ScreenID == item.ID).FirstOrDefault();
			if (user_Permission == null)
			{
				datatablePermassions.Rows.Add(item.ID, num, item.Screen_Name, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				datatablePermassions.Rows.Add(item.ID, num, item.Screen_Name, user_Permission.Allow_Enter, user_Permission.Allow_Save, user_Permission.Allow_Edit, user_Permission.Allow_Delete, user_Permission.Allow_Print, user_Permission.Allow_Export);
			}
			num++;
		}
		gridControl1.DataSource = datatablePermassions;
	}

	private void TxtGroups_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			GrpID = Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroups.SelectedValue);
			BindGridGroupsPrlivalges(Convert.ToInt32(TxtGroups.SelectedValue));
		}
		catch
		{
			GrpID = 1;
			BindGridGroupsPrlivalges(1);
		}
	}

	}

	private void CheckAll_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		foreach (DataRow row in datatablePermassions.Rows)
		{
			if (CheckAll.IsOn)
			{
				row[3] = true;
				row[4] = true;
				row[5] = true;
				row[6] = true;
				row[7] = true;
			}
			else
			{
				row[3] = false;
				row[4] = false;
				row[5] = false;
				row[6] = false;
				row[7] = false;
			}
		}
		gridControl1.DataSource = datatablePermassions;
		if (CheckAll.IsOn)
		{
			CheckEnter.IsOn = true;
			CheckEdit.IsOn = true;
			CheckDelete.IsOn = true;
			CheckPrint.IsOn = true;
			CheckSave.IsOn = true;
		}
		else
		{
			CheckEnter.IsOn = false;
			CheckEdit.IsOn = false;
			CheckDelete.IsOn = false;
			CheckPrint.IsOn = false;
			CheckSave.IsOn = false;
		}
	}

	public FrmUsers()
	{
		if (LoginDetails.Lang == "ar-EG")
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("ar-EG");
		}
		else
		{
			Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US");
		}
		InitializeComponent();
		Clear();
		BindCBBranch();
		BindCBGroups();
		BindGrid();
		((Control)(object)BtnSave).Enabled = true;
		((Control)(object)BtnEdit).Enabled = false;
		((Control)(object)BtnDelete).Enabled = false;

			CloseYear.HideButtons(BtnSave, BtnEdit, BtnDelete);
		}
	}

	private void FrmUsers_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
	{
		if (e.KeyCode.ToString() == "F4")
		{
			Clear();
		}
		else if (e.KeyCode.ToString() == "F5")
		{

		else if (e.KeyCode.ToString() == "F6")
		{
			Edit();
		}
		else if (e.KeyCode.ToString() == "F7")
		{
			Delete();
		}
	}

	private void gridEX1_MouseClick_1(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			int position = gridEX1.SelectedItems[0].Position;
			int id = Convert.ToInt32(gridEX1.GetRow(position).Cells[0].Text);
			LblID.Text = id.ToString();
			User_Login user_Login = (from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
				where x.ID == id
				select x).FirstOrDefault();
			TxtName.Text = user_Login.Name;
			TxtPassword.Text = Class_Encryption.DecryptString(user_Login.PassWord, user_Login.ID.ToString());
			CBGroups.SelectedValue = user_Login.GroupID;
			CBBranch.SelectedValue = user_Login.BranchID;
			Cksentfatora.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.SentXmlZakateNow);
			CHKActive.Checked = Convert.ToBoolean(user_Login.IsActive);
			TxtName.Focus();
			((Control)(object)BtnSave).Enabled = false;
			((Control)(object)BtnEdit).Enabled = true;
			((Control)(object)BtnDelete).Enabled = true;
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
	}

	private void CBBranch_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
	{
		try
		{
			int BID = Convert.ToInt32(CBBranch.SelectedValue);
			CBGroups.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllGroups()
				where x.BranchID == BID
				select x).ToList();
			CBGroups.DisplayMember = "Name";
			CBGroups.ValueMember = "ID";
			if (Convert.ToInt32(CBGroups.SelectedValue) == 0)
			{
				CBGroups.Text = "";
			}
			BindGrid();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			int BID2 = 1;
			CBGroups.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllGroups()
				where x.BranchID == BID2
				select x).ToList();
			CBGroups.DisplayMember = "Name";
			CBGroups.ValueMember = "ID";
			BindGrid();
		}
	}

	public static InputLanguage GetInputLanguageByName(string inputName)
	{
		foreach (InputLanguage installedInputLanguage in InputLanguage.InstalledInputLanguages)
		{
			if (installedInputLanguage.Culture.EnglishName.ToLower().StartsWith(inputName))
			{
				return installedInputLanguage;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private void SetKeyboardLayout(InputLanguage layout)
	{
		InputLanguage.CurrentInputLanguage = layout;
	}

	private void BindCBGroups()
	{
		int BID = Convert.ToInt32(CBBranch.SelectedValue);
		CBGroups.DataSource = (from x in USR.GetAllGroups()
			where x.BranchID == BID
			select x).ToList();
		CBGroups.DisplayMember = "Name";
		CBGroups.ValueMember = "ID";
		CBGroups.SelectedValue = 1;
	}

	private void BindCBBranch()
	{
		CBBranch.DataSource = USR.GetAllBranch();
		CBBranch.DisplayMember = "Name";
		CBBranch.ValueMember = "ID";
		CBBranch.SelectedValue = 1;
	}

	private void BindGrid()
	{
		int GID = Convert.ToInt32(CBGroups.SelectedValue);
		gridEX1.ColumnAutoResize = true;
		DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("gridEX1");
		dataTable.Columns.Add("كود", typeof(int));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("اسم المستخدم", typeof(string));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("باسورد", typeof(string));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("الفرع", typeof(string));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("المجموعة", typeof(string));
		dataTable.Columns.Add("الحالة", typeof(string));
		if (GID > 0)
		{
			foreach (User_Login item in from x in USR.GetAllUsers()
				where x.GroupID == GID
				select x)
			{
				string text = "نشط";
				if (item.IsActive == false)
				{
					text = "غير نشط";
				}
				dataTable.Rows.Add(item.ID, item.Name, item.PassWord, item.BranchID, USR.GetGroupName(Convert.ToInt32(item.GroupID)), text);
			}
			gridEX1.SetDataBinding((object)dataTable, "");
			gridEX1.RetrieveStructure();
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].Width = 30;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].RightToLeft = RightToLeft.No;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["الفرع"].Visible = false;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["باسورد"].Visible = false;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["المجموعة"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["اسم المستخدم"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["الحالة"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
		}
		else
		{
			dataTable.Clear();
			gridEX1.SetDataBinding((object)dataTable, "");
			gridEX1.RetrieveStructure();
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].Width = 30;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].RightToLeft = RightToLeft.No;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["الفرع"].Visible = false;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["باسورد"].Visible = false;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["المجموعة"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["كود"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["اسم المستخدم"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
			gridEX1.RootTable.Columns["الحالة"].TextAlignment = (TextAlignment)2;
		}
	}

	private void Clear()
	{
		TxtName.Text = "";
		TxtPassword.Text = "";
		CBBranch.SelectedValue = 1;
		CBGroups.SelectedValue = 1;
		CHKActive.Checked = true;

	private void Save()
	{
		if (CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventSave(LoginDetails.GroupID, 1))
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = Convert.ToInt32(CBGroups.SelectedValue);
			int num3 = Convert.ToInt32(CBBranch.SelectedValue);
			if (TxtName.Text != "" && TxtPassword.Text != "" && num2 > 0 && num3 > 0)
			{
				switch (MessageBox.Show("هل أنت متأكد من اضافة ( " + TxtName.Text + " ) الي المستخدمين", "تأكيد الحفظ", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question))
				{
				case DialogResult.Yes:
					num = USR.Insert(TxtName.Text, TxtPassword.Text, num3, num2, CHKActive.Checked, Cksentfatora.Checked);
					if (num > 0)
					{
						MessageBox.Show("تم حفظ بيانات المستخدم  ( " + TxtName.Text + " ) بنجاح", "نجاح الحفظ", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
						((Control)(object)BtnSave).Enabled = true;
						LoginDetails.SentXmlZakateNow = Cksentfatora.Checked;
						((Control)(object)BtnEdit).Enabled = false;
						((Control)(object)BtnDelete).Enabled = false;
						BindGrid();
						Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						MessageBox.Show(" تم حفظ بيانات المستخدم بنفس الاسم ( " + TxtName.Text + " ) لا يمكن التكرار", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
					}
					break;
				case DialogResult.No:
					TxtName.Focus();
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (TxtName.Text == "")
			{
				MessageBox.Show(" عفوا، ادخل اسم المستخدم ثم حاول مرة اخري", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				TxtName.Focus();
			}
			else if (TxtPassword.Text == "")
			{
				MessageBox.Show("عفوا، ادخل كلمة المرور ثم حاول مرة اخري", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				TxtPassword.Focus();
			}
			else if (num3 == 0)
			{
				MessageBox.Show(" عفوا، اختر الفرع ثم حاول مرة اخري", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				CBBranch.Focus();
			}
			else if (num2 == 0)
			{
				MessageBox.Show("عفوا، اختر المجموعة ثم حاول مرة اخري", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				CBGroups.Focus();
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

			}
			else if (TxtName.Text == "")
			{
				MessageBox.Show(" عفوا، ادخل اسم المستخدم ثم حاول مرة اخري", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);

	private void Delete()
	{
		if (CheckPermession.CheckUserPageEventDelete(LoginDetails.GroupID, 1))
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (TxtName.Text != "")
			{
				switch (MessageBox.Show("هل أنت متأكد من حذف ( " + TxtName.Text + " ) من المستخدم", "تأكيد الحذف", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question))
				{
				case DialogResult.Yes:
					num = USR.Delete(Convert.ToInt32(LblID.Text));
					if (num > 0)
					{
						BindGrid();
						MessageBox.Show("تم حذف بيانات المستخدم ( " + TxtName.Text + " ) بنجاح", "نجاح الحذف", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
						((Control)(object)BtnSave).Enabled = true;
						((Control)(object)BtnEdit).Enabled = false;
						((Control)(object)BtnDelete).Enabled = false;
						Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						MessageBox.Show("لا يمكن حذف ( " + TxtName.Text + " ) لوجود عمليات جارية بهذا المستخدم", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
					}
					break;
				case DialogResult.No:
					TxtName.Focus();
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MessageBox.Show("عفوا، اختر اسم المستخدم ثم حاول مرة اخري", "مستكشف البيانات", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
				((Control)(object)gridEX1).Focus();
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MessageBox.Show("عفوا، لايوجد لك صلاحية \r\n يرجي مراجعة مدير النظام لاعطائك صلاحية.", "مستكشف صلاحيات المستخدمين", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button3, MessageBoxOptions.RightAlign);
		}
	}

		BindGridByGroup();
	}

using System;
using System.Data.Entity;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GTSErpSystem.Dto;
using ZatcaIntegrationSDK;

namespace GTSErpSystem.Helper;

public class ResultElectronicInvoiceXmlService
{
	private GTSdbEntities _context = new GTSdbEntities();

	public async Task<int> AddResult(int userId, bool CsIdForUser, Result result, int branchId, bool uploaded, string orderId, DateTime created, string invoiceTypeName, string FatoraType)
	{
		if (result == null)
		{
			return 0;
		}
		ResultElectronicInvoiceXml invoiceXml = GenerateInvoice(result, branchId, uploaded, orderId, created, invoiceTypeName, FatoraType);
		_context.ResultElectronicInvoiceXmls.Add(invoiceXml);
		await ((DbContext)_context).SaveChangesAsync();
		await UpdateInvoiceHash(new CertificateRequestDto
		{
			InvoiceHash = result.InvoiceHash,
			BranchId = branchId,
			CsIdForUser = CsIdForUser,
			UserId = userId
		});
		return invoiceXml.Id;
	}

	private Result GenerateResult(ResultElectronicInvoiceXml resultElectronic)
	{
		//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		//IL_00fd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

	private ResultElectronicInvoiceXml GenerateInvoice(Result result, int branchId, bool uploaded, string orderId, DateTime created, string invoiceTypeName, string FatoraType)
	{
		return new ResultElectronicInvoiceXml
		{
			QRCode = result.QRCode,
			AllowanceTotalAmount = result.AllowanceTotalAmount,
			BranchId = branchId,
			ChargeTotalAmount = result.ChargeTotalAmount,
			EncodedInvoice = result.EncodedInvoice,
			InvoiceHash = result.InvoiceHash,
			IsValid = result.IsValid,
			LineExtensionAmount = result.LineExtensionAmount,
			SingedXMLFileNameFullPath = result.SingedXMLFileNameFullPath,
			UUID = result.UUID,
			TaxInclusiveAmount = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(result.TaxInclusiveAmount), 1).ToString(),
			PayableAmount = Math.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(result.PayableAmount), 1).ToString(),
			TaxAmount = result.TaxAmount,
			TaxExclusiveAmount = result.TaxExclusiveAmount,
			Uploaded = uploaded,
			OrderId = orderId,
			Created = created,
			ErrorMessage = result.ErrorMessage,
			NormalXMLFileNameFullPath = result.NormalXMLFileNameFullPath,
			NormalXMLFileNameShortPath = result.NormalXMLFileNameShortPath,
			SingedXMLFileNameShortPath = result.SingedXMLFileNameShortPath,
			Operation = result.Operation,
			PIH = result.PIH,
			PrepaidAmount = result.PrepaidAmount,
			ResultedValue = result.ResultedValue,
			SingedXML = result.SingedXML,
			SingedXMLFileName = result.SingedXMLFileName,
			InvoiceTypeName = invoiceTypeName,
			FatoraType = FatoraType
		};
	}

	public async Task<int> UpdateInvoiceHash(CertificateRequestDto requestDto)
	{
		if (requestDto.CsIdForUser)
		{
			User_Login user = ((IQueryable<User_Login>)_context.User_Login).FirstOrDefault((User_Login s) => (int?)s.ID == requestDto.UserId);
			if (user != null)
			{
				user.InvoiceHash = requestDto.InvoiceHash;
				((DbContext)_context).Entry<User_Login>(user).State = (EntityState)16;
				await ((DbContext)_context).SaveChangesAsync();
				return 1;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			TblSetting branch = ((IQueryable<TblSetting>)_context.TblSettings).FirstOrDefault((TblSetting s) => (int?)s.ID == requestDto.BranchId);
			if (branch != null)
			{
				branch.InvoiceHash = requestDto.InvoiceHash;
				((DbContext)_context).Entry<TblSetting>(branch).State = (EntityState)16;
				await ((DbContext)_context).SaveChangesAsync();
				return 1;
			}
		}
		return 0;
	}
}
